jobs.title: Project Manager, Enterprise Implementations
jobs.description:
**Project Manager, Enterprise Implementations**
===============================================

**About the Role**
------------------


As a Project Manager, Enterprise Implementations, you will lead complex, customer\-facing SaaS implementation projects for enterprise customers. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of coordination and accountability throughout the implementation lifecycle, partnering closely with customers and internal stakeholders to deliver successful business outcomes.


You will manage high\-impact implementation projects that require exceptional communication, stakeholder management, risk mitigation, and organizational skills. Success in this role requires the ability to navigate ambiguity, drive accountability across multiple teams, and build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders while delivering projects on time and within scope.


As part of a cross\-functional delivery organization, you will collaborate with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Operations, and customer teams to ensure seamless implementation experiences and measurable customer value.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Project Leadership \& Delivery**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise SaaS implementation projects from project kickoff through deployment and project closure.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, resource allocations, and success measures.
* Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and change requests throughout the project lifecycle.
* Drive accountability across internal and external stakeholders to ensure project commitments are met and implementation objectives remain on track.
* Facilitate project governance activities including stakeholder meetings, executive reviews, status reporting, and decision\-making forums.
* Partner with customers to establish implementation strategies that align technology delivery with business objectives.

### **Customer \& Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout implementation engagements.
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and executive sponsors.
* Provide clear, proactive communication regarding project status, risks, milestones, and outcomes.
* Guide customers through complex implementation journeys, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and confident throughout the process.
* Facilitate alignment across customer teams, technical stakeholders, and executive leadership.

### **Risk Management \& Problem Resolution**

* Proactively identify project risks, issues, and dependencies and develop effective mitigation plans.
* Escalate concerns appropriately while maintaining focus on customer outcomes and project success.
* Resolve complex project challenges involving competing priorities, resource constraints, or changing business requirements.
* Maintain project momentum and accountability in fast\-paced and evolving environments.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Leverage project management best practices and implementation methodologies to drive consistent delivery outcomes.
* Conduct retrospectives and apply lessons learned to improve future project execution.
* Utilize project management, reporting, automation, analytics, and AI\-enabled tools to enhance efficiency and visibility.
* Contribute to continuous improvement efforts that strengthen delivery excellence and customer satisfaction.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5\+ years of experience leading enterprise SaaS implementations, technology deployments, digital transformation initiatives, or complex customer\-facing projects.
* Proven experience delivering software implementation projects involving multiple stakeholders, business functions, and technical teams.
* Experience managing external customer\-facing projects and serving as the primary project lead throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Strong project planning, risk management, governance, and stakeholder management experience.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in complex, fast\-paced environments.
* Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Experience influencing stakeholders across all organizational levels, including executive leadership.
* Proficiency with project management and collaboration platforms such as Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, Asana, Monday.com, or similar tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* PMP, Agile, Scrum Master, SAFe, PgMP, or equivalent certification.
* Experience leading enterprise software or SaaS implementations.
* Experience working with large, complex customers requiring coordination across multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Knowledge of systems integration, data migration, change management, and implementation methodologies.
* Experience utilizing AI\-enabled project management, reporting, forecasting, or analytics tools.

**Success in This Role**
------------------------


Successful candidates will demonstrate the ability to confidently lead enterprise implementation projects while building trust with customers and stakeholders. They will create structure in ambiguous situations, effectively manage competing priorities, and consistently drive projects toward successful outcomes.

**Senior Bridge Project Manager**

**Position Overview**

Fought \& Company is seeking an experienced **Senior Bridge Project Manager** to help drive the continued growth of one of the West Coast's premier bridge and heavy fabrication programs. Based in the Pacific Northwest, Fought is strategically focused on complex bridge structures, heavy plate fabrication, railroad bridges, and infrastructure that strengthens America's transportation network.

This position may be **100% remote** for the right candidate.

We are looking for a bridge builder.

Fought \& Company is expanding its Bridge \& Heavy Fabrication team and seeking a Senior Bridge Project Manager with deep experience delivering complex steel bridge projects across the Pacific Northwest.

This is not an entry point into bridge work. We are looking for someone who knows the industry, understands the DOT environment, has managed significant bridge projects, and can anticipate problems before they become problems.

**Qualifications**

The right person will bring:

* Significant steel bridge project management experience
* A long history working in the Pacific Northwest bridge market
* Deep understanding of owners, general contractors, schedules, contracts, fabrication, erection, and project risk
* The judgment and confidence to lead complicated projects and difficult conversations
* Strong relationships and a reputation for doing what they say they will do

**Compensation**

$165,000 \- $185,000 annually, DOE. Final offer will depend on experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

**Why Fought**

At Fought, we believe great projects are built by great people. We invest in relationships, embrace complex challenges, and pursue continuous improvement every day. Fought is building something different: a bridge\-focused organization with significant fabrication capacity, a growing Western footprint, and the ambition to become the premier outsourced Bridge \& Heavy Fabrication partner in the West. If you have spent your career building bridges in the PNW and believe your experience can help us build what comes next, **we should talk.**

**Opportunity Grows Here.**

Email us at grit@foughtsteel.com

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Prime Data Centers**


Prime Data Centers develops, acquires, and operates data centers for some of the world's largest enterprises. A private firm owned by a group controlling $6 billion in assets, with a 15\-year tenure in technology and real estate development, Prime provides customers with ownership options and dynamic leasing models, defining a true corporate partnership.

 **About the role**


 Enable D\&E leaders to scale by owning the planning, coordination, and execution mechanics of a growing project portfolio — so the team spends its time leading and building, not chasing status.


D\&E is a small, high\-leverage team carrying a workload that outpaces its headcount. This is a high\-impact Individual Contributor (IC) role with broad visibility across Design, Engineering, Construction, Procurement, and Operations — not a project\-coordination or administrative seat. You'll have real influence over how D\&E plans, tracks, and delivers, how D\&E develops and designs for the future, and real accountability for whether that execution is predictable.


This role is intentionally banded across “Sr.” and “Principal” levels — final leveling, title, and compensation will be calibrated to the experience and scope the selected candidate brings, not fixed in advance.

**What you'll do**

**PROGRAM PLANNING \& EXECUTION**

* Establish and maintain systems to enable D\&E's design, engineering, and construction workstreams.
* Define milestones, success criteria, and delivery timelines; own the systems (Asana, Procore, and equivalents) that make status answerable in one lookup, not a scramble.
* Track progress and surface risk, scope, and schedule tradeoffs early enough for leaders to act on them — not after they've already landed.
* Progress programmatic initiatives to ensure a scalable, industry\-leading D\&E team into the future.

**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION**

* Serve as the connective tissue between D\&E and Construction, Operations, Commercial, Development, Procurement, and Sustainability — driving alignment on process, priorities, and sequencing, not just reporting on them.
* Facilitate decision\-making forums and escalation paths; hold teams accountable to agreed plans and timelines without relying on formal authority.
* Represent D\&E's program status and risk posture directly to stakeholders and leadership, including in forums the VP, Design \& Engineering isn't in.

**METRICS, REPORTING \& OPERATING RHYTHM**

* Define and maintain program dashboards and status reporting for D\&E leadership and cross\-functional partners.
* Support quarterly and monthly planning cadences, including RFP/procurement tracking and Prime Engineering Standards distribution to stakeholders.
* Identify and close recurring process gaps — a report nobody trusts, a handoff that keeps dropping — without being told to.
* Facilitate third\-party business reviews to ensure true collaborative partnerships are maintained.

**Qualifications**

* 6\+ years leading technical programs or complex initiatives — construction, real estate development, infrastructure, or complex hardware/engineering environments strongly preferred.
* Strong systems thinking; able to translate strategy into executable, trackable plans — and to build the tracking systems (Asana, Procore, or equivalent) that make that possible for others, not just yourself.
* Confidence working across senior technical and business stakeholders — comfortable pushing back on an unrealistic date or dependency with data, not staying quiet.
* Thrives in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments — you'll be building parts of this operating rhythm from scratch, not running an existing playbook.
* Data center, hyperscale, or mission\-critical facilities experience is a strong plus, not a requirement.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification is a strong plus, not a requirement.

 **Benefits**

* Competitive salary range and performance bonus program
* 401k fully vested upon enrollment, up to a 4% employer match
* 100% employee premiums paid by employer for medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability
* Paid Time Off \+ Sick time

*Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.*  

  

Prime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants are considered for employment without attention to race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, protected veteran or military status, disability status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Social Impact
jobs.description:
The American Diabetes Association (ADA) is seeking a Project Manager to join our Program Management Office. The Project Manager has overall responsibility for managing scope, budgets, timelines, project teams, stakeholders, vendors, and contractual deliverables across multiple projects that improve the lives of people living with diabetes. Reporting to the Program Director, this role supports the PMO in standardizing project management processes (with a focus on efficiency), ensuring strategic alignment and effective program delivery, and fostering collaboration across teams. The Project Manager will support ADA mission\-driven success on PMO initiatives and programs while promoting accountability and impact.

  


**Responsibilities**


* Leads cross\-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within budget
* Aligns resources to accomplish project tasks and key milestones with clear accountability for project deliverables
* Communicates and collaborates with development and marketing teams to provide training and information required to promote and seek funding for new projects, programs, and systems.
* Directs the work of a project team with overall responsibility for managing scope, budget, timeline, staffing and stakeholders, vendors, and contractual deliverables.
* Accountable for project deliverables, overall project success, and supporting contract renewals to expand ADA’s offerings.
* Serves as a liaison between internal and external stakeholders, volunteers, customers, and vendors.
* Maintains process documentation and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement for all organization initiatives.
* Facilitates quality management and change management techniques for project management.
* Effectively estimates and plans project resources, schedules, and budgets.

  


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree required
* Minimum expected years of relevant experience: 5 years in project management and/or delivery of programs, products, or services
* Project Management Professional (PMP)® certification is preferred
* Understanding of project management methodologies, such as PMBOK
* Demonstrated proficiency in project management software (e.g. MS Project or Smartsheets)

  


**Skills**


* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong sense of urgency
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to form and lead high\-performing teams
* Critical thinking and the ability to manage complex projects
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills
* Strong change management skills
* Demonstrates a high level of personal accountability and holds others accountable for results
* Fosters collaboration and cooperation to deliver results
* Strong planning, organization, and attention to detail
* Good negotiation skills
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and work independently to manage multiple concurrent projects

  


**Why Work Here**  

The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) offers a rewarding career working for one of the premier voluntary health organizations in the world supporting people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Our employees consistently say that our mission, culture, work\-life balance, and total rewards package are what they like most about working at the ADA. benefits and our culture:


* Industry competitive base pay. Base offers are determined by several factors including but not limited to your relevant work experience, education, certifications, location, internal pay equity, etc.
* A culture of recognition including new hire welcome announcements, service anniversary awards, referral bonuses, monthly All Employee Assembly, appreciation awards
* Generous Paid Time Off, including holidays, vacation days, personal days and sick days
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), disability \& life insurance, pet insurance, and retirement savings
* Guided by our mission, we provide full diabetes supply coverage through our medical benefits program
* A company focus on offering mental health programs and work/life balance with most of our employees working remote
* Joining our dedicated team affords the gratification of knowing beyond a doubt that you will impact the lives and well\-being of millions

  


**About the Organization**  

The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) is the nation’s leading voluntary health organization fighting to end diabetes and helping people living with diabetes thrive. Since 1940, we have driven discovery and research to prevent, manage, treat, and ultimately cure diabetes. We advocate for policy changes and improved access to quality care for all people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Through the Obesity Association, a division of the ADA, we are also working to reduce the prevalence of obesity—a leading risk factor for type 2 diabetes.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Ting Data Products
jobs.description:
**About Ting Labs**

  

Ting Labs is the company behind Ting, an electrical fire prevention sensor active in more than 1\.3 million homes across North America. A single Ting sensor takes 30 million measurements per second; across the fleet, the result is one of the largest continuous, high\-resolution datasets ever assembled on the residential electrical grid.

  

Ting’s sensor fleet captures, in real time, what is actually happening on the grid downstream of grid\-side sensors. Utility operations and planning teams can use this distributed telemetry to improve the reliability and resilience of an electrical grid under unprecedented pressure. Ting Data Products is a new line of business that packages this data—through portals, APIs, files, dashboards, and other interfaces—for utilities and other institutional buyers who can put it to work. Visit tingfire.com for more information.

 **About the Role**


We are seeking a highly motivated Program Manager to manage the implementation, delivery, and ongoing customer success of Ting Data Products programs for electric utilities, government agencies, emergency\-management organizations, and other institutional customers.

  

This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role focused on making customer programs work. You will coordinate onboarding, product and data access, launch readiness, recurring program reviews, issue resolution, and ongoing delivery. Strong execution and a positive customer experience will be critical to the adoption and success of Ting Data Products.

  

You will serve as a day\-to\-day point of contact for customers and coordinate across Product, Engineering, Sales, subject\-matter experts, Marketing, Finance, and Operations. You will turn customer commitments into clear plans, track progress and open issues, and make sure the right people are engaged at the right time.

  

Customer needs will vary—from system\-level monitoring, event intelligence, and retrospective analysis to sensor\-level detail, and from use of the Ting Utility Grid Portal to APIs integrated into existing systems. This role is well suited to someone who is comfortable with technical products, enjoys customer interaction, and brings strong organization, judgment, and follow\-through.

  

The role reports to the Director of Program Management.

 **What You'll Do::**

* **Program delivery.** Manage the day\-to\-day delivery of customer programs from kickoff through launch and ongoing operation. Maintain clear plans, milestones, owners, action items, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
* **Customer onboarding and readiness.** Coordinate product access, data delivery, documentation, training, and launch\-readiness activities so customers are prepared to use Ting Data Products successfully.
* **Ongoing customer success.** Establish regular customer cadence, understand customer goals and use cases, track adoption, coordinate value reviews, and help customers get meaningful value from Ting data.
* **Customer support and issue resolution.** Serve as a responsive first point of contact for program questions and product issues. Triage requests, engage the appropriate technical or subject\-matter experts, communicate status, and follow issues through resolution.
* **Program health and reporting.** Monitor implementation progress, product usage, customer outcomes, risks, feedback, and open issues. Prepare clear updates for customers and internal stakeholders.
* **Cross\-functional coordination.** Bring together Product, Engineering, Sales, data infrastructure, subject\-matter experts, Marketing, Operations, and customer teams to keep work aligned and moving forward. Travel to client sites as business and program needs require.
* **Customer feedback and continuous improvement.** Capture customer needs, recurring issues, and product feedback; route insights to the appropriate internal teams; and help improve the product and customer experience over time.

 **What We're Looking For:**

* **Customer\-facing program experience.** 4\+ years of relevant experience in program management, implementation, customer success, consulting, product operations, or customer delivery within a B2B technology, SaaS, or data environment.
* **Relevant industry experience.** Experience supporting technology, data, or operational programs for electric utilities or similarly complex institutional or public\-sector customers. Direct electric utility experience is strongly preferred; experience with government agencies or emergency\-management organizations is a plus.
* **Customer\-success mindset.** You listen carefully, understand what customers are trying to accomplish, and take practical steps to help them adopt the product, and realize value.
* **Technical aptitude.** Experience working with data products, analytics platforms, APIs, enterprise software, or technical integrations. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable discussing data access, permissions, integration dependencies, and data quality with technical teams.
* **Strong program execution.** You can manage multiple workstreams, maintain clear plans and action items, identify risks early, and make sure commitments do not fall through the cracks.

jobs.description:

* Minimum 5–7 years of experience supporting information assurance, cybersecurity, RMF, or information system security, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience supporting federal cybersecurity programs and the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF).
* Experience developing and maintaining RMF documentation, authorization packages, and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tools.
* Strong knowledge of NIST SP 800\-37, NIST SP 800\-53, FISMA, FIPS 199, and federal privacy requirements.

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance (CGRC) or Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)


Preferred Qualifications
  
* Experience supporting U.S. federal civilian agencies, preferably the USPTO.
* Experience with continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and security automation.
* Familiarity with cloud security, DevSecOps, and continuous authorization initiatives.
* Knowledge of privacy compliance activities, including Privacy Threshold Assessments (PTAs), Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and System of Records Notices (SORNs).

jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst III - Temporary position
jobs.description:
About Crisis24
  
Crisis24 is a global, AI\-enhanced provider of travel risk management, mass communications, critical event management, crisis\-security consulting, personal protection solutions and global medical concierge capabilities, allowing prominent organizations, disruptive brands and influential people to operate with confidence in an uncertain world. Backed by proprietary AI\-enabled SaaS technologies, advanced Global Operations Centers, an extensive global footprint, and the largest team of private\-sector intelligence analysts in the world, we deliver localized insights and global perspectives alongside medical, security, crisis response, embedded intelligence, and consultancy services as a preferred partner for Fortune 500 corporations.
  
At Crisis24, we don't just offer jobs – we offer missions. We recruit the very best from the military, intelligence agencies, academia, law enforcement, medicine, or any of our areas of specialty. We protect more than places. We protect people, reputations, and lifestyles, with integrity, discipline, discretion, and purpose. Whether you're stepping into civilian life after service, seeking personal or professional growth, or bringing specialized expertise to a higher calling, we match your ambition with real opportunity. Do the most important work of your career, helping safeguard the world's most important organizations and individuals against risk.
  
More information is available at https://www.crisis24\.com/careers
  
  

Who We Are Looking For
  
  

Under the general direction of the Embedded Intelligence Services (EIS) department, the Intelligence Analyst III will support the analytical needs of a major client engagement. The Analyst will work directly with their Manager and the EIS team to produce analysis that addresses client\-specific requirements. The Analyst will be available to travel to client locations as needed. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required on a case\-by\-case basis. This role is based at the Crisis24 Annapolis, MD office or remote, and is a temporary remote position starting mid\-September 2026 through mid\-January 2027\.
  
  

What You Will Work On
  
  

In coordination with Crisis24 EIS Managers, and in accordance with appropriate guidance: actively monitors open\-source media, third\-party subscription services, and other sources in real time for issues that could affect business operations and personnel; open\-source intelligence collection and analysis of regional trends and events to provide timely, comprehensive, customized intelligence products to decision makers; develops client\-specific intelligence products including, but not limited to: Travel Threat Assessments, Location Threat Assessments (Neighborhood\-, City\-, or Country\-level), Site Threat Assessments, Event Threat Assessments, Requests for Intelligence, Daily Incident Assessments or Intelligence Products, Threat Forecasting, Scenario Forecasting, Social Media Monitoring, Online Exposure Assessments; liaise with the client to better understand their requirements and concerns, and understand the client’s operational footprint; manages client expectations by understanding the EIS team's product offerings and limitations; Establishing and maintaining positive professional rapport with other analysts and SME as well as client contacts; supports manager in tracking metrics around production; and assists in managing emergency incidents by using judgment and skills in accordance with commonly accepted incident management best practices and client policies and procedures.
  
  

What You Will Bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in intelligence analysis, threat assessment, incident response, or a related field required
* Excellent research skills and the ability to mentor analysts in how to research and evaluate sources.
* Exceptional analytic writing skills and the ability to mentor other analysts in analytic writing.
* Excellent verbal briefing skills and the ability to mentor other analysts in verbal briefing.
* Ability to mentor other analysts in analytic skills.
* Subject matter expertise in a location, security\-related topic, or analytic process is a bonus.
* Foreign language and travel experience required.
* Customer service experience required; ability to support complex engagements a plus.
* Experience overseeing other analysts' work is a plus.
* Experience leading projects with several other analysts.
* Effective problem\-solving skills.
* Fast learner and ability to multitask.
* Ability to organize and prioritize work with little supervision.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Knowledge of Google Earth and Maps.


Important Note About This Position
  
  

This is a temporary remote position starting mid\-September 2026 and ending mid\-January 2027\. This position focuses on geopolitical risk, global threat intelligence, and monitoring events that could disrupt client operations, including political, economic, social, and security factors, as well as natural events such as severe weather and other disasters. The role emphasizes qualitative research, investigative analysis, and intelligence reporting rather than technical, IT, cybersecurity, data analytics, or business intelligence functions. Potential applicants with primary experience in technical or data\-centric fields should carefully consider whether this role aligns with their background.
  
  

**Note:** This is a temporary position starting mid\-September 2026 and ending mid\-January 2027
  
* Flexible hours and workdays are required to meet Crisis24's core 24/7 mission.
* Required to be available to travel to client locations as needed.
* Candidates will be asked to pass a background check as well as writing and technology aptitude screenings as a condition of employment.


Information Security
  
* Protect the data and systems of Crisis24

The HR Project Manager provides disciplined project management across a high\-volume portfolio of Human Resources initiatives. Ensures HR projects are effectively planned, organized, resourced, tracked, communicated, and delivered in alignment with established objectives, timelines, and priorities. jobs.description:
**About the Role**
  

  

The Senior Program Manager, M\&A is a high\-impact, leadership role that serves as a **principal architect of the M\&A People strategy and operational methodology** . You will move beyond managing individual transactions to leading a portfolio of complex, high\-stakes integrations and owning the scalability of the entire People M\&A function. This role requires deep People domain expertise, a strategic planning mindset, and the proven ability to influence senior leaders and navigate significant global ambiguity. You have to be comfortable pushing back on the business and other key stakeholders. You will be accountable for defining success metrics, managing execution risk across multiple jurisdictions, and ensuring the M\&A process delivers a world\-class employee experience.
  

  

**What You'll Do**
* **Lead and govern a portfolio** of concurrent, high\-stakes M\&A transactions, accountable for end\-to\-end People workstream execution across multiple, often conflicting, global legal and regulatory frameworks.
* **Spearhead the resolution** of highly ambiguous and structurally complex integration challenges, including global compensation harmonization, collective bargaining/labor council negotiation strategy, complex HRIS data migration, and global mobility issues.
* **Drive rigorous due diligence** processes, synthesizing complex legal, HR, and cultural data into clear, actionable recommendations for deal structuring and risk mitigation.
* **Develop and maintain robust, high\-trust cross\-functional partnerships** with Corporate Development, Legal, Finance, and IT/Systems teams to ensure seamless data and operational integration.

**Basic Qualifications*** **Minimum 10\+ years** of progressive professional experience, with a focus on large\-scale program management, consulting, or strategic operations.
* **Minimum 7\+ years** leading complex, multi\-functional programs, demonstrating the ability to manage ambiguity and drive decision\-making under pressure.

**Preferred Qualifications*** **Deep, demonstrable M\&A People/HR domain expertise** , including experience in Due Diligence, organizational design, change management, and post\-close integration.
* **Executive Presence:** Proven ability to communicate complex M\&A strategies and risks clearly and concisely to executive leadership (VP/SVP level).
* **Global Acumen:** Experience navigating integrations across EMEA, APAC, or LATAM, with a working knowledge of international labor law, works councils, and cross\-border compensation practices.
* **Strategic Foresight:** Ability to think three steps ahead of the current deal, anticipating regulatory changes, organizational conflicts, and system limitations that will impact future scalability.
* **Technology \& Systems:** Strong understanding of core HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday) and the data migration, security, and integration challenges inherent in M\&A.
* **Education:** BA/BS/Masters in Business, HR, Law, or a related field.

  

  

For New York City, NY\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $175,000 per year \- USD $194,000 per year.  

  

For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $175,000 per year \- USD $194,000 per year.  

  

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  

  

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. jobs.title: Product Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Mammoth Brands**



Mammoth Brands (formerly Harry's Inc.) is the modern CPG company behind brands Harry's, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. We're building a new model—and home—brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples' lives, and ultimately challenge the status quo. Our mission is to "Create Things People Like More." Simply put: everything we do should be better than what already exists. If it's not, we don't do it. This guides everything we do, from developing the best product experiences, to making Mammoth Brands a great place to work, to exploring innovative ways to give back to our community.



We got our start in 2013 when our co\-founders created Harry's. They built the brand differently—online first, prioritizing direct relationships with customers—and in the process learned they'd created something bigger: a playbook and platform that could help other brands grow and scale to their full potential, and a vision to reimagine consumer packaged goods. Today, Mammoth Brands is a growing portfolio of brands and the largest CPG company built in the last 20 years. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: to create a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. As a company, we're also committed to making a positive impact and have donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date.



We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day\-to\-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.



  

**About the team**



The Global Product Team is responsible for all aspects of product development and design from ideation through production. The team leads the company's largest product initiatives through the creation, development, and testing of innovative, high\-quality goods that will be sold to and experienced by customers all over the world.



Within the Product Team, the Program Management team is responsible for overall program scoping, driving cross\-functional teams to define and execute development and design strategy, and ensuring all workstreams ladder up successfully to launch new products.

  


**About the Role**



We're looking for a proactive, detail\-oriented leader who thrives in ambiguity and loves making things happen. This is an ideal role for someone eager to own big outcomes and grow within a fast\-moving product organization.



As a Product Program Manager, you'll lead cross\-functional workstreams and teams at all levels through thoughtful planning, execution, and support from concept through product launch. You'll manage a high volume of commercial initiatives and bundles. Success in this role means being a doer who brings structure, builds relationships, and drives momentum across functions.

  


**What you will do:**


* Drive execution across a high volume of product programs, primarily commercial and bundle initiatives, from scoping through launch
* Lead cross\-functional teams through development planning, timelines, and risk mitigation to ensure deliverables align with business goals
* Collaborate across product development, marketing, sourcing, operations, quality, finance, design, and sales to move work forward quickly and efficiently
* Work with domestic and international suppliers and manufacturers throughout development
* Clearly communicate updates, blockers, and decisions to stakeholders, including senior leadership, tailoring messages to different audiences
* Identify and implement workflow, tool, or process improvements that enable faster, more efficient execution


**This should describe you:**


* Bachelor's degree and 2\+ years experience in roles that require ownership, coordination, and execution. This can include rotational programs, operations, finance, or product development. Industry experience in CPG, startups, or fast\-paced environments a plus but not required
* No technical background required. We care more about your ownership, drive, and ability to get teams aligned and moving
* You are a self\-starter with strong judgment and a proven track record of accountability. You don't wait to be told what to do, and you're energized by figuring things out
* You bring structure to chaos by breaking down complexity, asking the right questions, and keeping others focused on what matters
* You communicate clearly and confidently across stakeholders, internal and external, senior and peer\-level
* You identify problems, own solutions, and take pride in driving outcomes rather than simply completing tasks
* You build trust quickly across teams, balancing input from multiple stakeholders while staying focused on the goal
* You are curious, adaptable, and resilient in the face of ambiguity, shifting priorities, or unexpected challenges
* You bring a positive outlook and a sense of humor. We take our work seriously and ourselves less so
  


**Here's who you'll work with:**


* Working on the Product Program Management team, which is part of the Global Product team
* Working closely with Product Development, Package Development, Marketing, Global Supply, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Sales, and Design teams as well as external supplier/vendor partners

  


**Benefits and perks**


* **Medical, dental, and vision coverage**
* **401k match**
* **Equity in Mammoth Brands**
* **Flexible time off and working hours**
* **L\&D stipend**
* **4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years**
* **20 fully paid weeks off for parents who give birth, or 16 fully paid weeks off for all other paths to parenthood**
* **Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building even

jobs.title: Transmission Planning Project Manager - 1898 & Co.
jobs.description:
**Description**


At 1898 \& Co., we are helping shape the future of transmission systems across North America. Our Transmission Planning and Power Systems Analysis team works with a diverse mix of clients—investor\-owned utilities, public power entities, developers, and ISOs/RTOs—to deliver smart, resilient, and future\-ready electric grid solutions. As part of Burns \& McDonnell, we bring together decades of experience, a deep bench of technical talent, and a spirit of innovation to solve some of the most critical infrastructure challenges of our time. We're looking for a Transmission Planning Project Manager who brings a strong mix of technical knowledge and leadership capability. This is a high\-impact role for someone passionate about solving complex power system problems, developing teams, and working directly with clients on critical planning studies and system improvements. Are you ready to help drive the energy transition forward?


**What You’ll Do**


As a Transmission Planning Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all phases of transmission planning projects, from business development through execution. You will manage multidisciplinary teams, develop scope and fee structures, ensure quality deliverables, and maintain strong client relationships. You’ll also be a mentor and resource for growing talent within our team. Key responsibilities include:


Business Development


* Cultivate and grow client relationships through marketing efforts, project interactions, and strategic engagement.
* Identify and pursue new sales opportunities with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and developers.
* Lead proposal development, project scoping, budgeting, and scheduling activities.
* Set critical project objectives with clients and lead contract development and negotiations.

Project Execution


* Manage the full lifecycle of transmission planning projects including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client communication.
* Lead risk assessment processes and procedures using industry best practices.
* Direct and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams of engineers and analysts.
* Communicate project status, risks, and costs to stakeholders and executive leadership.

Leadership \& Mentorship


* Train and mentor junior staff on both technical and project management aspects of transmission planning.
* Champion internal initiatives that promote team growth and technical excellence.
* Serve as a go\-to technical expert in transmission system planning and evaluation.

Technical Responsibilities


* Perform and lead advanced transmission planning studies, including steady\-state, transient stability, short circuit, voltage analysis, and production costing.
* Apply and interpret regulatory standards (NERC, FERC, and regional policies) to ensure compliant and forward\-thinking planning.
* Utilize tools like PSS®E, PSLF, PowerWorld, PSCAD, EMTP/ATP, ETAP, and Promod to perform complex power system modeling and analysis.
* Resolve technical challenges related to transmission planning and present clear, actionable solutions to project stakeholders.

**Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, computer science or related field from an accredited program and 5 years of related professional experience.
* Knowledge in project management, techniques, and procedures.
* Excellent computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong organizational skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Experience leading technical aspects of consulting engagements in regards to power systems, distribution planning, and grid modernization.
* Experience on consulting projects, client operations, or executing program management within the critical infrastructure industry.
* Understanding of general business and financial principles.
* Experience with communicating across business segments to understand project objectives.

**Compensation**


$140,000\.00\-375,000\.00 Yearly


The expected compensation range for this position is displayed in compliance with all local/state regulations. The expected compensation range for this position is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to: individual education, qualifications, prior work experience and work location. The total annual compensation package will consist of a base salary and eligibility to participate in our discretionary year\-end incentive bonus program.


**Benefits**


Our extensive benefits package takes care of you so that you can focus on doing great work. From insurance and disability to time off and wellness programs, we provide the tools to meet your needs. As part of being 100% employee\-owned, eligible employees participate in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) in addition to our 401(k) retirement program. For more information, please visit the Benefits \& Wellness page.


This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

We innovate today to fuel our clients’ future growth, catalyzing insights that drive smarter decisions, improve performance and maximize value. jobs.description:
SECURITY OPERATIONS MANAGER  

We are excited to invite a passionate and experienced Security Operations Manager to join our team! Homes for the Homeless (HFH) is searching for a Security Operations Manager for our Families w/ Children facility in the Williamsbridge area of the Bronx, NY. As the Security Operations Manager, you will play a pivotal role in our organization, overseeing the performance of our dedicated Safety Aides in ensuring a collaborative and supportive environment, where our team can excel and provide the best safety to our families. Join us and be a part of an organization that values your contribution and cares deeply for the community we serve.  

ABOUT HOMES FOR THE HOMELESS:
Homes for the Homeless operates shelters for families experiencing homelessness in NYC. Our family residences are more than just a place to sleep. Families can make the most of their stay through accessing an array of onsite programs. Many of these programs are also available to people living in the local community. Our goal is to have a positive impact so families can thrive long after they leave our shelters.  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:* Manage and supervise assigned shift staff.
* Ensures compliance with security and FDNY protocols, reports, and regulations.
* The ability to train staff on protocols and procedures, as well as proper use of equipment.
* Comfortable with conducting workshops for staff.
* Train staff on incident report writing.
* Keep all critical files up to date.
* Strong administrative skills.
* Respond to emergency situations.
  

QUALIFICATIONS:* **Valid NYS Security Guard License.**
* **F\-02 Certification required.**
* **F\-80 Certification required.**
* T\-89 Fire and Life Safety Director (FLSD) Certification preferred.
* High School diploma or equivalent.
* A minimum of five (5\) years of experience with at least one (1\) year of supervisory experience in a similar position.
* Working knowledge of fire safety codes and regulations at a supervisory level.
* Working knowledge, operating surveillance camera systems and related technology.
* The ability to stand, sit and walk for an extended period of time.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  

COMPENSATION/EEO:
In order to attract and retain a high\-performance workforce, Homes for the Homeless offers a dynamic and rewarding work environment, with a focus on ensuring an appropriate work\-life balance. In addition to a competitive salary, full\-time permanent employees are eligible for excellent benefits including comprehensive health insurance (including medical, dental, and vision), an employer\-funded 403(b) retirement plan, commuter benefits, life insurance, Work/Life Assistance Program, 3 weeks paid vacation, 10 sick days, 3 personal days and 12 paid holidays.

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. **Exciting Opportunity at MSK:** Project Manager, Capital Procurement (Planning, Design \+ Construction)


The Project Manager, Capital Procurement supports Planning, Design \& Construction’s capital project portfolio by developing procurement strategies, coordinating complex sourcing activities, and improving the processes, tools, and reporting used to procure design, construction, consulting, FF\&E, equipment, and related capital\-project goods and services.

The Project Manager coordinates procurement activities from early planning and scope development through solicitation, evaluation, recommendation, award, and transition to contract and purchase\-order administration.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**WHY JOIN AGU**  

Our employees are our most valuable assets! You will feel welcomed and supported from the moment you join our team, and you will take part in strengthening and evolving our workplace culture.  

We offer work\-life balance and innovative benefits.* Work\-life balance: remote\-first organization, flexible work hours, unlimited PTO, Flexible Fridays, paid holidays, military leave, parental leave.
* Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life Insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, wellness, tuition reimbursement, 403(b) retirement plan, FSA, HSA, theft protection, personal and professional development, and much more.

**WHO WE ARE**  

The American Geophysical Union (AGU) supports a global community of more than half a million professionals and advocates in the Earth and space sciences.  

Through broad and inclusive partnerships, AGU aims to advance discovery and solution science that accelerates knowledge and creates solutions that are ethical, unbiased, and respectful of communities and their values. Our programs include serving as a scholarly publisher, convening virtual and in\-person events, and providing career support. We live our values in everything we do, such as our net\-zero energy renovated building in Washington, D.C., and our Ethics and Equity Center, which fosters a diverse and inclusive geoscience community to ensure responsible conduct.
This is an exciting time to work at AGU. Every day we approach our work with a sense of purpose, and we look for others who share that passion and desire for a career with impact.**WHO YOU ARE**
As the Project Manager you will support AGU’s mission to advance Earth and space sciences for the benefit of humanity by planning and delivering projects that meet established scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance expectations.
You are responsible for coordinating the execution, implementation, and completion of assigned projects. This includes developing project plans, establishing timelines and budgets, identifying resource needs, tracking progress, managing risks and issues, and coordinating the work of cross\-functional team members, vendors, and consultants. The Project Manager ensures that project activities remain aligned with organizational priorities and that changes to scope, schedule, or budget are appropriately evaluated, documented, and communicated.
Working collaboratively with project sponsors, customers, and other stakeholders, the Project Manager helps define project objectives, requirements, deliverables, roles, and measures of success. The position facilitates meetings, maintains project documentation, prepares status reports, supports informed decision\-making, and escalates significant risks or barriers when necessary.
You will receive general direction and applies established project management practices, policies, and procedures to assigned work. Success in this role requires strong organizational, analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills; sound judgment; attention to detail; and the ability to build productive working relationships, manage competing priorities, and guide teams toward successful project outcomes.**WHAT YOU WILL DO**  

Manage assigned projects from initiation through completion, applying established PMO processes, tools, and project management practices.* Collaborate with project sponsors, customers, and cross\-functional teams to define project scope, objectives, success criteria, requirements, and deliverables.
* Identify project stakeholders and develops appropriate communication and engagement approaches to keep them informed and involved throughout the project lifecycle.
* Work with sponsors, team members, contractors, and consultants to develop project deliverables, resource requirements, work plans, budgets, schedules, and measures of success.
* Develop and maintains project plans, schedules, budgets, communication plans, risk registers, decision logs, status reports, and other required project documentation.
* Organize and coordinates project activities, meetings, dependencies, and deliverables to support timely and effective execution.
* Monitor project budgets, forecasts expenses, reviews financial performance, and communicates potential budget variances to the project sponsor and appropriate leadership.
* Identify project resource needs and works with functional managers and project sponsors to secure the staff, contractors, consultants, and other resources required for successful delivery.
* Coordinate the work of cross\-functional project teams, contractors, and consultants, ensuring that roles, responsibilities, expectations, and deadlines are clearly understood.
* Establish an appropriate schedule and format for project status reporting and provides clear, accurate, and timely updates on progress, accomplishments, risks, issues, decisions, budgets, and upcoming activities.
* Monitor project progress against established scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance requirements and takes corrective action when necessary.
* Identify, documents, tracks, and supports the resolution of project risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and barriers, escalating significant concerns when appropriate.
* Manage proposed changes to project scope, schedule, budget, resources, or deliverables through established change\-control processes.
* Develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans to reduce the potential impact of project risks and unexpected challenges.
* Assign and coordinates project tasks, follows up on commitments, and promotes accountability among project team members while recognizing that functional managers retain responsibility for employee supervision and performance management.
* Facilitate productive project meetings and discussions, helping teams resolve conflicts, make decisions, and maintain progress toward agreed\-upon outcomes.
* Build collaborative working relationships with project sponsors, team members, customers

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. You will architect global lifecycle and firmware maintenance programs and drive remote support performance to ensure zero operational downtime. By leveraging health telemetry and building strong cross\-functional partnerships, you will directly influence how our physical security systems are maintained and secured while reducing the fleet’s overall risk profile.

* Develop and monitor performance KPIs for system uptime and resolution efficiency, while designing telemetry dashboards to enhance remote diagnostic tools and provide real\-time visibility into device health.

**Senior BIM/VDC Project Manager**



Remote, Full\-Time (Some Travel) Exempt Reports to: Director of VDC / Operations

 **About Ayoroa Simmons**



Ayoroa Simmons is one of the most trusted reality capture and BIM firms in the Eastern United States, with a client roster that includes some of the largest AEC organizations in the country and the U.S. Department of Defense. For over a decade, we have delivered surveying, laser scanning, Scan to BIM, and BIM/VDC services as a fully integrated offering, giving project teams the accurate existing\-conditions data they need to design, build, and manage with confidence.

  

With a 35\+ person team and a track record on complex institutional, healthcare, and infrastructure projects, we bring the scale and precision standards that this work demands. Ayoroa Simmons is an established firm at a growth inflection point, and we're building toward the clients who need us most.

 **Position summary**



Ayoroa Simmons is seeking a Senior BIM/VDC Project Manager to lead model\-based coordination and digital delivery across complex AEC projects, while supporting client relationships, strategic pursuits, and firm growth. The ideal candidate brings technical credibility and client\-facing leadership, managing BIM/VDC execution, advising project teams, and representing the firm in pursuits.



This is a fully remote role with some travel expected.

 **Key responsibilities**


*BIM/VDC project leadership*


* Align BIM/VDC scope, schedule, budget, and staffing with overall project goals.
* Lead BIM/VDC execution from pursuit and preconstruction through construction and closeout, including BIM Execution Plans, model coordination strategies, and deliverable schedules.
* Serve as primary BIM/VDC point of contact for owners, design teams, contractors, trade partners, and internal staff.
* Establish QA/QC protocols for models, documentation, and coordination milestones; identify risks early and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Support and guide Project Leads in running multidisciplinary coordination meetings, clash detection workflows, constructability reviews, and issue resolution, staying actively engaged while empowering Project Leads to own day\-to\-day meeting leadership.

  


*Client relationships \& pursuits*


* Build and maintain relationships with clients, contractors, design partners, and industry stakeholders; identify opportunities for new work, expanded services, and follow\-on assignments.
* Support go/no\-go decisions, capture planning, proposal development, and win strategy for BIM/VDC\-related opportunities.
* Participate in client meetings, shortlist presentations, and pursuit strategy sessions; contribute technical content and value propositions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor, translating client goals into BIM/VDC scopes, work plans, and deliverables.
* Manage assigned consultants and trade partners, including coordination of their scope, project invoicing, and billing.
* Represent Ayoroa Simmons at industry events and conferences; partner with principals and marketing to align VDC capabilities with firm growth.

  


*Technology, standards \& process improvement*


* Develop and maintain BIM/VDC standards, templates, workflows, and best practices across projects and offices.
* Evaluate and select BIM/VDC software, including Autodesk, Bluebeam, and comparable platforms, to advance leading industry workflows and production.
* Drive innovation in Revit and coordination workflows, extending the firm's established leadership in scanning and reality capture; implement automation, dashboards, and emerging technologies (4D scheduling, digital twins, reality capture, prefabrication).
* Train and mentor project teams on coordination processes, tools, and digital delivery expectations.

  


*Team leadership \& mentorship*


* Supervise, mentor, and develop BIM/VDC coordinators, specialists, and modelers.
* Provide technical guidance to project managers, discipline leads, and field teams.
* Foster a collaborative, solutions\-oriented environment; promote knowledge sharing across projects and markets.

  


**Required qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field; equivalent experience welcomed.
* 8\+ years in BIM, VDC, construction technology, or digital project delivery, including 3\+ years leading BIM/VDC on complex AEC projects.
* Demonstrated experience supporting client relationships, pursuits, proposals, or presentations.
* Advanced proficiency with Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Forma, and similar platforms.
* Experience developing BIM Execution Plans, clash detection workflows, and model standards.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills; ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.

  


**Preferred qualifications**


* Experience in healthcare, commercial, higher education, infrastructure, or mission\-critical sectors.
* Established client or industry network in the Eastern U.S. AEC market.
* Experience with 4D/5D integration, digital twins, laser scanning, reality capture, or prefabrication workflows.
* Familiarity with Power BI, automation, scripting, or model\-based analytics.
* Experience with project scheduling (Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project).
* Professional certifications: CM\-BIM, PMP, DBIA, LEED AP, or Autodesk certification.

  


**Key competencies**



BIM/VDC technical leadership · Client relationship management · Project delivery accountability · Constructability judgment · Pursuit \& proposal support · Team mentorship · Process improvement · Data\-driven decision\-making

 **Success measures**


* On\-time delivery of BIM/VDC scope, milestones, and model standards.
* Reduction in coordination issues, RFIs, rework, and field conflicts.
* Client satisfaction, repeat work, and new opportunities identified or supported.

**Description**

**The World Bank Group Vision and Strategy**
Working at the World Bank Group provides a unique opportunity for you to help our clients solve their greatest development challenges. The World Bank Group is one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries; a unique global partnership of five institutions dedicated to ending extreme poverty, increasing shared prosperity and promoting sustainable development. With 189 member countries and more than 190 offices worldwide, we work with public and private sector partners, investing in groundbreaking projects and using data, research, and technology to develop solutions to the most urgent global challenges. Visit www.worldbank.org

**Global Corporate Solutions and Corporate Real Estate**
Reporting directly to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Administration Officer (MDCAO), Global Corporate Solutions (GCS) brings together the functions of Corporate Security, Corporate Real Estate, and Corporate Services (such as food services, printing, travel, conferences, and translation and interpretation).


GCS’s Corporate Real Estate (GCSCR) division plays a crucial role in supporting IBRD, IDA, MIGA, and ICSID by developing and operating their real estate demands worldwide. The Senior Program Manager position reports to the Manager, GCSCR HQ Real Estate Development and Management. The position is responsible for the strategic oversight and day\-to\-day management of all building engineering and HVAC systems across a 5 million square foot commercial office portfolio. This position provides senior\-level direction to a team of licensed building engineers who deliver 24/7 building operations, ensuring the highest standards of systems reliability, energy performance, occupant comfort, and regulatory compliance.


This role serves as the principal subject matter expert for all mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and HVAC systems across the portfolio and partners closely with the building maintenance and project delivery teams to align engineering operations with organizational goals. **Duties and Accountabilities**

* Provide coaching and mentoring of staff to inspire and motivate them to perform at their highest level.
* Drive a culture of safety, accountability, and operational excellence within the engineering team.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, set measurable KPIs, and implement professional development programs for all direct reports.
* Address performance issues quickly, consistently, and fairly.
* Ensure that access to appropriate training is available to all staff and establish annual development goals for all team members.
* Hold staff accountable for the timely delivery and quality of their work.

**Building Engineering and Operations:*** Oversee all aspects of building engineering and operations for the HQ campus, ensuring uninterrupted 24/7 functionality of HVAC systems and compliance with health, safety, sustainability, and building standards.
* Regularly review and refine operational processes and procedures to drive continuous improvement and maximize staff efficiency.
* Stay informed on industry developments, emerging technologies, and evolving workplace models to integrate best practices into operational strategies.
* Monitor ongoing projects and initiatives within the unit to effectively balance team workload, prioritize tasks, and guarantee the consistent and timely execution of projects.
* Foster collaboration with other units and contractors to coordinate project activities, ensuring efficient completion and high levels of client satisfaction.
* Develop and monitor preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs to maximize system uptime and equipment life cycles.

**Budget Management:**

* Identify and prioritize capital investment needs through systematic condition assessments and life\-cycle cost analyses.

* Develop the plan for budget allocation for engineering operations based on yearly plan for projects using capital and overhead funding.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment - Electrical Design Assurance, NA
jobs.description:
**About Vantage Data Centers**
==============================

  

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Reliability Engineering**


The Reliability Engineering Department is responsible for ensuring the operational health of critical systems and the implementation of Site Operations best practices. This includes evaluating the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure, maintaining operational availability through maintenance programs, and providing technical support to Site Operations teams. The department also collaborates closely with the Design Engineering team to provide feedback for future data center designs.

**Position Overview**

**This role will be based near any of our North America office locations, following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

The Sr. Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment \- Electrical Design Assurance is responsible for providing operationally focused electrical review and technical assurance for new data center builds, expansions, and major fit\-out projects across the North America portfolio. This role represents Site Operations and Site Deployment during design development, page\-turn reviews, submittal reviews, RFI responses, commissioning strategy alignment, and movement of design packages toward Issued for Construction drawings.


The position ensures that electrical systems are designed and delivered in a manner that is operable, maintainable, safe, reliable, and aligned with long\-term Mission Critical Operations requirements. Working closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and local Site Operations teams, this role brings operator perspective into electrical design decisions before construction execution, procurement, and turnover activities create downstream operational risk.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Serve as the primary Site Deployment representative for electrical design assurance across assigned campuses, projects, and expansions.
* Participate in design page\-turn reviews and provide operator\-focused comments from concept design through IFC drawing issuance.
* Review electrical design packages, one\-line diagrams, specifications, sequences of operation, equipment schedules, load studies, and drawing sets for operability, maintainability, safety, and reliability.
* Review electrical submittals, equipment selections, vendor documentation, and proposed alternates to evaluate operational impact, maintainability requirements, protection strategy, and lifecycle risk.
* Support responses to RFIs related to electrical distribution, equipment access, switching, redundancy, load management, protection coordination, EPMS interfaces, maintenance clearances, and long\-term serviceability.
* Evaluate value engineering proposals and design changes to ensure critical operational requirements are not removed, reduced, or compromised without appropriate risk visibility.
* Provide technical input for electrical commissioning strategies, operational acceptance criteria, test scripts, integrated systems testing, energization plans, and turnover readiness expectations.
* Collaborate with Site Deployment TPMs and future MCO teams to ensure electrical design intent is carried forward into construction, commissioning, training, CMMS population, and steady\-state operations.
* Capture lessons learned from active operating sites and deployment projects and feed them back into future electrical design standards, templates, and review criteria.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review electrical design milestones including 30%, 60%, 90%, IFC, bulletin, and construction revision packages.
* Assess utility service arrangements, medium\-voltage distribution, low\-voltage distribution, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, generators, fuel systems interfaces, transfer schemes, busways, panels, grounding, lightning protection, batteries, and EPMS architecture.
* Validate maintenance access, equipment clearances, working space, switching paths, isolation strategy, arc flash considerations, labeling, redundancy philosophy, and operational workflows within electrical spaces.
* Track design review comments, assigned actions, and open electrical issues through closure with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Site Operations stakeholders.
* Participate in recurring design coordination meetings, page turns, constructability reviews, operability reviews, energization planning, and commissioning planning sessions.
* Review MEP coordination impacts where electrical systems interface with mechanical, controls, fire protection, security, architectural, structural, civil, and utility scopes.
* Provide operator perspective on sequence of operations, switching procedures, alarm strategy, metering, trending capability, EPMS points, electrical safety requirements, and emergency operating scenarios.
* Review proposed equipment substitutions or manufacturer deviations for potential impacts to maintainability, spare parts, training, warranty, resilience, and operational standardization.
* Support development of operational design standards, electrical review checklists, lessons learned repositories, and acceptance criteria used by the Site Deployment organization.
* Partner with local MCO leadership to ensure future operators understand electrical design intent, operating limitations, maintenance requirements, and known risk items prior to turnover.

**Job Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in data center operations, electrical engineering, commissioning, critical facilities maintenan

**About Vantage Data Centers**
==============================

  

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Reliability Engineering**  

The Reliability Engineering Department is responsible for ensuring the operational health of critical systems and the implementation of Site Operations best practices. This includes evaluating the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure, maintaining operational availability through maintenance programs, and providing technical support to Site Operations teams. ##### **About Peraton**


Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **About The Role**


Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission\-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.


At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission you’ll define it. Lead the work that keeps America flying safely.

This role sits at the heart of aviation modernization, where disciplined execution, technical excellence, and mission impact converge. If you thrive in environments where precision matters, collaboration is essential, and your work has national significance, this role offers both challenge and purpose.

* This position is required to be on\-site, primarily located in Herndon, VA, with an alternate work location available in Bowie, MD. Candidates must be able to work on\-site at one of these locations based on program requirements.

* Support requirements analysis, system testing, readiness reviews, and operational transitions.
* Champion continuous improvement, bringing structure, consistency, and efficiency to complex engineering efforts.
* Drive projects to successful completion while meeting FAA standards, cost targets, and delivery commitments.

**Technical Leadership \& Collaboration**


* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional teams spanning software, hardware, networking, RAN, and systems integration.
* Partner closely with vendors, engineers, and program leaders to ensure seamless execution across all technical domains.
* Provide clear, confident briefings and milestone updates to FAA and senior program stakeholders.

**Risk Management with Real Impact**


* Anticipate and resolve technical risks, dependencies, and integration challenges—especially within network and infrastructure deployments.
* Ensure issues are identified early and addressed decisively to protect mission outcomes.

**Trusted Stakeholder Partner**


* Serve as the primary bridge between technical teams, program management, and FAA leadership.
* Maintain transparent communication and strong relationships that enable informed decisions and sustained confidence.
  

**Why You’ll Want This Role:**

  

Few roles offer the opportunity to apply deep technical and project management expertise at a scale that truly matters. In this position, your leadership directly supports aviation safety, cybersecurity, and infrastructure modernization across the National Airspace System.

  

**Your work will:**

  

* Influence systems relied upon by millions of travelers every day
* Support FAA initiatives that enhance safety, capacity, and resilience
* Place you at the center of high\-profile, mission\-critical programs

**Required Qualifications:**


* U.S. Citizenship Required.
* Must have the ability to obtain / maintain a Public Trust clearance.
* 10 years of relevant experience
* Demonstrated success managing technical, engineering, or IT infrastructure projects.
* Hands\-on Network Engineering, Cybersecurity or Software Testing experience.
* Strong understanding of project management principles, risk management, and performance tracking.
* Proven ability to manage project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, and dependencies using structured project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).

* Proven ability to develop and manage detailed project schedules and budgets.
* Ability to conduct technical reviews, validation activities, and post\-implementation assessments.

* Exposure to FAA programs or NAS systems.
* Experience supporting FAA NextGen, air traffic management systems, or federal technology modernization efforts.
