**Work Location:** Remote
  
Key Responsibilities
  
* Serve as the primary cybersecurity and privacy advisor to System Owners for assigned systems.
* Lead RMF activities, including development and maintenance of System Security and Privacy Plans (SSPPs), authorization packages, risk documentation, and supporting artifacts.
* Ensure systems maintain Authorization to Operate (ATO) through assessment support, continuous monitoring, and compliance with NIST RMF, FISMA, and federal security requirements.
* Assess security risks, validate security controls, and coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA\&Ms).
* Maintain system inventories, security documentation, contingency plans, configuration management plans, and privacy documentation.
* Collaborate with ISSMs, System Owners, Security Control Assessors, and technical teams to integrate security throughout the system lifecycle.
* Monitor system security posture, review vulnerability and compliance scan results, and support continuous authorization initiatives.
* Provide cybersecurity guidance, develop security policies and procedures, and deliver security awareness training.
* Support security engineering, certification and accreditation activities, and implementation of security controls across systems.
* Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to enhance RMF and cybersecurity operations.
* Perform independent quality assurance reviews of program performance and deliverables to ensure that contractual obligations are being met.


Required Qualifications
  
* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–7 years of experience supporting information assurance, cybersecurity, RMF, or information system security, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience supporting federal cybersecurity programs and the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF).
* Experience developing and maintaining RMF documentation, authorization packages, and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tools.
* Strong knowledge of NIST SP 800\-37, NIST SP 800\-53, FISMA, FIPS 199, and federal privacy requirements.
* Experience supporting Authorization to Operate (ATO), Continuous ATO (cATO), or Continuous Authorization efforts.
* Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Expertise in cybersecurity processes and protection of technical architecture.


Required Certifications
  
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

* Experience with continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and security automation.

jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst III - Temporary position
jobs.description:
About Crisis24
  
Crisis24 is a global, AI\-enhanced provider of travel risk management, mass communications, critical event management, crisis\-security consulting, personal protection solutions and global medical concierge capabilities, allowing prominent organizations, disruptive brands and influential people to operate with confidence in an uncertain world. Backed by proprietary AI\-enabled SaaS technologies, advanced Global Operations Centers, an extensive global footprint, and the largest team of private\-sector intelligence analysts in the world, we deliver localized insights and global perspectives alongside medical, security, crisis response, embedded intelligence, and consultancy services as a preferred partner for Fortune 500 corporations.
  
At Crisis24, we don't just offer jobs – we offer missions. We recruit the very best from the military, intelligence agencies, academia, law enforcement, medicine, or any of our areas of specialty. We protect more than places. We protect people, reputations, and lifestyles, with integrity, discipline, discretion, and purpose. Whether you're stepping into civilian life after service, seeking personal or professional growth, or bringing specialized expertise to a higher calling, we match your ambition with real opportunity. Do the most important work of your career, helping safeguard the world's most important organizations and individuals against risk.
  
More information is available at https://www.crisis24\.com/careers
  
  

Who We Are Looking For
  
  

Under the general direction of the Embedded Intelligence Services (EIS) department, the Intelligence Analyst III will support the analytical needs of a major client engagement. The Analyst will work directly with their Manager and the EIS team to produce analysis that addresses client\-specific requirements. The Analyst will be available to travel to client locations as needed. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required on a case\-by\-case basis. This role is based at the Crisis24 Annapolis, MD office or remote, and is a temporary remote position starting mid\-September 2026 through mid\-January 2027\.
  
  

What You Will Work On
  
  

In coordination with Crisis24 EIS Managers, and in accordance with appropriate guidance: actively monitors open\-source media, third\-party subscription services, and other sources in real time for issues that could affect business operations and personnel; open\-source intelligence collection and analysis of regional trends and events to provide timely, comprehensive, customized intelligence products to decision makers; develops client\-specific intelligence products including, but not limited to: Travel Threat Assessments, Location Threat Assessments (Neighborhood\-, City\-, or Country\-level), Site Threat Assessments, Event Threat Assessments, Requests for Intelligence, Daily Incident Assessments or Intelligence Products, Threat Forecasting, Scenario Forecasting, Social Media Monitoring, Online Exposure Assessments; liaise with the client to better understand their requirements and concerns, and understand the client’s operational footprint; manages client expectations by understanding the EIS team's product offerings and limitations; Establishing and maintaining positive professional rapport with other analysts and SME as well as client contacts; supports manager in tracking metrics around production; and assists in managing emergency incidents by using judgment and skills in accordance with commonly accepted incident management best practices and client policies and procedures.
  
  

What You Will Bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in intelligence analysis, threat assessment, incident response, or a related field required
* Excellent research skills and the ability to mentor analysts in how to research and evaluate sources.
* Exceptional analytic writing skills and the ability to mentor other analysts in analytic writing.
* Excellent verbal briefing skills and the ability to mentor other analysts in verbal briefing.
* Ability to mentor other analysts in analytic skills.
* Subject matter expertise in a location, security\-related topic, or analytic process is a bonus.
* Foreign language and travel experience required.
* Customer service experience required; ability to support complex engagements a plus.
* Experience overseeing other analysts' work is a plus.
* Experience leading projects with several other analysts.
* Effective problem\-solving skills.
* Fast learner and ability to multitask.
* Ability to organize and prioritize work with little supervision.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Knowledge of Google Earth and Maps.


Important Note About This Position
  
  

This is a temporary remote position starting mid\-September 2026 and ending mid\-January 2027\. This position focuses on geopolitical risk, global threat intelligence, and monitoring events that could disrupt client operations, including political, economic, social, and security factors, as well as natural events such as severe weather and other disasters. The role emphasizes qualitative research, investigative analysis, and intelligence reporting rather than technical, IT, cybersecurity, data analytics, or business intelligence functions. Potential applicants with primary experience in technical or data\-centric fields should carefully consider whether this role aligns with their background.
  
  

**Note:** This is a temporary position starting mid\-September 2026 and ending mid\-January 2027
  
* Flexible hours and workdays are required to meet Crisis24's core 24/7 mission.
* Required to be available to travel to client locations as needed.
* Candidates will be asked to pass a background check as well as writing and technology aptitude screenings as a condition of employment.


Information Security
  
* Protect the data and systems of Crisis24

jobs.title: Cloud Threat Analyst
jobs.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
  
  

ASRC Federal is hiring a Cloud Threat Analyst in support of our Defense Counterintelligence Security Agency (DCSA) program based out of Hanover MD.
  
Team members may be required to report to Fort Meade daily if required, however Remote flexibility available! Telework offered with a requirement to be onsite up to one (1\) day a week in Hanover MD. (5 days in the office has not been required to date)
  
  

**Position Description:**  

As the Cloud Threat Analyst, your primary duty is to safeguard our national security systems through proactive threat hunting and advanced threat detection activities. You will continuously monitor and analyze threat intelligence sources to stay informed about emerging threats, searching for signs of malicious activity across our network infrastructure, endpoints, and systems that evade traditional security solutions. A key part of your role involves developing and implementing new and innovative threat detection techniques and strategies, analyzing large datasets to identify patterns and anomalies indicative of malicious activities, and mapping adversary tactics to the MITRE ATT\&CK framework. You will collaborate with other CSOC team members and stakeholders to respond to and investigate security incidents, perform in\-depth forensic analysis to understand the nature and impact of threats, and provide detailed reports and briefings on threat hunting activities and findings to senior management.
  
  

**Minimum Requirements:**  

* 2\+ years of system\-level cybersecurity experience in one of the following areas:
* Cyber Security Analyst, Incident Response and Threat Hunting as part of a mid to large enterprise red team or threat hunt team.
* Enterprise vulnerability management, endpoint security, or web security within a mid to large enterprise.
* Active Top\-Secret Clearance, eligible for TS/SCI.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Security or related field, or equivalent combination of experience.
* Must meet DoD 8140/8570\.01\-M IAM II or IAT Level II requirements (e.g., CCNA Security, CySA\+, GICSP, Security\+ CE, CND, SSCP, CAP, CASP\+ CE, CISM, CISSP (or Associate), GSLC, CCISO, HCISPP, CEH, Pentest\+, OSCP, CSSP\-IR). At least one certification is required.


**Required Skills:**  

* Able to read, decipher and understand system, network, or cloud logs
* Knowledge of basic Enterprise and Network operations.
* Knowledge of NIST Cybersecurity Framework and/or ISO 27001 (specifically focused on incident response procedures, including containment, eradication, and recovery.)
* Basic understanding of Mitter Attack framework
* Communication \& Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively articulate technical findings and collaborate with diverse teams.


**Recommended skills:**  

Threat Hunting \& Detection
  
* Conduct proactive threat hunting activities to detect advanced threats that evade traditional security solutions
* Continuously monitor and analyze threat intelligence sources to stay informed about emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack vectors
* Search for signs of malicious activity across network infrastructure, endpoints, cloud environments, and systems
* Develop and implement new and innovative threat detection techniques and strategies
* Analyze large datasets using SIEM platforms and security analytics tools to identify patterns and anomalies indicative of malicious activities
* Tune detection logic and alerting to reduce false positives and improve threat detection fidelity


Threat Intelligence \& Analysis
  
* Leverage threat intelligence sources to identify emerging threats targeting federal environments and national security systems
* Map adversary activity to MITRE ATT\&CK framework and develop threat models
* Analyze advanced persistent threats (APTs) and understand adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs)
* Recommend defensive improvements based on observed threat actor behaviors and attack patterns
* Correlate threat intelligence with internal security events to identify potential compromises


Incident Response \& Investigation
  
* Collaborate with other CSOC team members and stakeholders to respond to and investigate security incidents
* Perform in\-depth forensic analysis to understand the nature, scope, and impact of threats
* Conduct root cause analysis and impact assessments for security incidents
* Support containment, eradication, and recovery efforts during security incidents
* Coordinate response actions with SOC analysts, engineering teams, system owners, and government stakeholders
* Document incidents, response actions, and remediation recommendations in accordance with government reporting requirements


**Reporting \& Documentation:**  

* Provide detailed reports and briefings on threat hunting activities and findings to senior management
* Develop and maintain threat hunting playbooks, processes, and procedures
* Document lessons learned and contributed to the continuous improvement of security operations
* Create and maintain technical documentation for detection rules, hunting queries, and analytical methodologies
* Clearly document findings, response actions, and technical recommendations


Continuous Improvement \& Compliance
  
* Participate in the development and refinement of security monitoring and incident response tools and processes
* Assist with security documentation, evidence collection, and audit response

* 10004409
* Fairfax, VA

**Department:** University Life


**Classification:** Financial Services Specialist 1


**Job Category:** Classified Staff


**Job Type:** Full\-Time


**Work Schedule:** Full\-time (1\.0 FTE, 40 hrs/wk)


**Location:** Fairfax, VA


**Workplace Type:** Hybrid Eligible  

  



**Sponsorship Eligibility:** Not eligible for visa sponsorship


**Pay Band:** 04


**Salary:** Salary range starting in the mid $60k's; commensurate with education and experience  

  



**Restricted:** Yes


**Criminal Background Check:** Yes


**About the Department:**


Housing and Residence Life (HRL) is a self\-supporting auxiliary organization within the University Life unit of George Mason University. HRL serves a highly diverse population of approximately 6,200 students, the majority of which are undergraduates living in 40 traditional, suite, and apartment\-style residence halls in three campuses within the vibrant Northern Virginia area. HRL employs over 170 full\-time and graduate staff members and over 350 undergraduate student staff members. HRL is committed to providing a safe, well\-maintained student\-centered environment that is innovative and all\-inclusive of the global community. It is dedicated to creating a home that enriches the experiences of our students, staff, and faculty.


**About the Position:**


The Business Analyst (BA) position serves as a liaison between the Residential Services Assignments team and Housing Residence Life Finance team ensuring the accurate flow of residential student occupancy and billing data reflects on Mason finance systems. The Business Analyst utilizes the occupancy management platform to support data integrity, billing accuracy, and occupancy management processes. This position provides various monthly reconciliations for auditor reviews and develops revenue recognition solutions as needed. The Business Analyst also serves as the initial Housing Residence Life point of contact for audit coordination and compliance reporting at Mason and other state audit processes, and works collaboratively with departmental, divisional, and university finance personnel to ensure Housing Residence Life's revenues are accurate and aligned with university financial regulations. This position reports to the Director of Housing Residence Life Finance and Business Services and serves as a liaison to the Director of Residential Services in matters related to finance.


**Responsibilities:**


**Management, System and Data Analysis**


* Ensures accurate timing and processing of data transmissions related to room rental billing to ensure consistency in data reporting;
* Supports data accuracy efforts within the occupancy management platform by generating reports and reviewing data integrity;
* Collaborates and communicates with HRL IT and Residential Services staff to provide support for the housing management system from a financial perspective; troubleshoots technical issues and identifies needs within the system following established guidelines, creates manuals as needed, and implements long term plans for system improvements as appropriate;
* Advises the Chief Housing Officer (CHO), Director of Residential Services, and Director of HRL Finance and Business Services on the impact of business processes and makes recommendations for adjustments as needed according to payment and contractual processes in the HRL room rental application; includes consideration of historical contractual and occupancy changes and review of proposed changes to identify and address potential processing issues or financial concerns;
* Reviews, analyzes, and identifies areas for improvement for HRL's occupancy and financial reporting systems, documents current practices, and supports automation initiatives to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and data consistency;
* Conducts ad hoc analysis to investigate ongoing or singular operational issues and adjusts HRL processes in accordance with evolving institutional practices as needed;
* Creates informative, actionable and repeatable financial occupancy reporting to illustrate occupancy impact on the HRL budget and highlight relevant business trends and opportunities for improvement;
* Stays informed on changes to the housing management system through proactive professional development and attendance of related conference and training opportunities; and
* In collaboration with the Assistant Director of Assignments \& Applications Specialist, the Summer Operations Business Manager, and IT unit, develops and maintains financial system workflows, reporting tools, and dashboards to support the contracting, invoicing, payment, and posting/reconciling of Summer revenues from external clients to the university’s central financial management system; provides support and guidance for system transitions to Summer Operations colleagues.

**Finance**


* Performs monthly revenue reconciliations between databases to identify discrepancies in room rental revenues for the academic year and summer operations, and ensures proper documentation for audit purposes;
* Generates and distributes manual invoices for external groups utilizing Mason’s spaces for summer camps and conferences and follows up accordingly to ensure payments are received and posted accurately;
* Coordinates with HRL Summer Operations colleagues to support accurate and timely client billing and payment postings in the university’s central financial management system, ensuring financial accuracy and enabling efficient revenue collection;
* Collaborates with Mason Financial Planning and Analysis staff to help update coding in the Mason General Ledger Interface File, ensuring correct revenue postings from the housing management platform system to the university’s central financial management system;
* Supports the Director of HRL Finance and Business Services in monthly revenue forecasting and contributes to the preparation of HRL modeling

jobs.title: Security Analyst - CPE Ground
jobs.description:
**Candidates must have an active Secret clearance and verify, before applying, that you meet the minimum requirements of the position.**


**POSITION DESCRIPTION \- SECURITY ANALYST**


**Position Title:** Security Analyst (Supporting CPE Ground)  

**Program:** CPE Ground \- Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA)  

**Customer:** Department of War / Department of the Army  

**Location:** Fort Belvoir, VA (100% On\-site)  

**Clearance Requirement:** Active Secret Security Clearance  

**Contract Period of Performance:** Good through January 2031


**Salary Range:** 75K\-85K Annual; commensurate with Education/Experience


**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Security Specialist IV provides high\-level technical expertise and analytical support for Department of Defense (DoD) security programs and program protection operations. Based on\-site at Fort Belvoir, VA, the specialist independently manages multi\-disciplinary security tracks across physical, personnel (PERSEC), industrial (INDUSEC), and operations security (OPSEC/Anti\-Terrorism) domains. This role is responsible for processing workforce compliance pipelines, navigating specialized defense tracking networks, and delivering data\-driven metrics to senior leadership within the Acquisition and Enterprise Support Directorate.


**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


**1\. Core Security Operations \& Metrics Tracking**


* Maintenance and daily oversight of the Security Office Actions Tracker, capturing data on verification requests, Visit Authorization Requests (VAR), personnel actions, foreign travel compliance, and incoming taskers.
* Compiles, structures, and presents daily and monthly security metrics to produce the weekly Security Office Actions briefings used during the Acquisition and Enterprise Support Directorate synchronization meetings.
* Author, review, and apply analytical research methods to develop comprehensive program protection documentation, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOP).


**2\. Personnel \& Industrial Security Management (PERSEC / INDUSEC)**


* Orchestrates personal security clearance tracks using the Personnel Security Investigation Portal (PSIP), including initiating Form Updates, managing Tier 3 (T3\) initial background investigations, and tracking personnel compliance timelines.
* Coordinates and schedules biometric/fingerprinting requirements for newly onboarded or upgrading total force personnel requiring active background vetting.
* Validates, creates, and submits Visit Authorization Requests (VAR) directly within the Defense Information System for Security (DISS).
* Audits, processes, and tracks access provisioning requests via DD Form 2875 System Access requests utilizing automated frameworks like Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) and the Army Enterprise Systems Integration Program (AESIP).
* Manages facility access control pipelines, including reviewing and completing RTI39 Compound Badge Requests for on\-site personnel.


**3\. Foreign Travel Vetting \& Compliance**


* Pre\-screens, validates, and cross\-references clearance levels, mandatory foreign clearance training, country\-specific hazard maps, and visa requirements for personnel deploying on personal or official foreign travel.
* Operates the Aircraft Personnel Automated Clearance System (APACS) to secure organizational approval for international transit.
* Navigates DISS network criteria to upload, report, and maintain records for required foreign travel categories; conducts formal security debriefs and records completed travel closure statements in DISS upon return.
* Maintained total program compliance by reviewing and updating the Derivative Classification Training Certificate tracker in strict accordance with USD(I) Policy Memorandums.


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


**Education \& Experience**


* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university.
* **Experience Baseline:** Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience managing multi\-disciplinary DoD security programs, program protection, or military intelligence environments.


**Technical Vetting Tools \& Systems**


* **Vetting \& Security Systems:** Full operational proficiency within DISS, PSIP, and APACS.
* **Access Management:** Hands\-on experience Routing DD2875 packets through digital channels, ICAM, and AESIP systems.
* **Security Frameworks:** Foundational knowledge of DoD Directive 5200\.01 (DoD Information Security Program), NISPOM, Derivative Classification parameters, and OPSEC metrics.
* **Communication:** Proven ability to respond to ad\-hoc security inquiries in a high\-tempo environment, provide clear policy guidance, and manage cross\-functional taskers.

jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


Operations Research Analysts provide decision makers with sound, quantitative information as a basis for making decisions. They apply rigorous methods of scientific inquiry and use mathematical, statistical, and econometric analysis techniques to support Agency projects or problem solving studies. They research and analyze proposed changes to programs and operations to determine their impact on pe


Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Clarification from the agency**


External Applicants Only


  
**Duties**
----------


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: The National Geospatial\-Intelligence Agency (NGA) serves as the world leader in providing timely, relevant, accurate and actionable geospatial intelligence (GEOINT). NGA's civilian, military and contract personnel evaluate imagery, maps, charts, multiple layers of foundation data \- such as terrain, elevation and gravity \- and the full spectrum of visible and invisible light in order to help users visualize what is happening at a particular place and time. Our intelligence officers go beyond describing 'what, where and when' to revealing 'how and why.' Our work enables decision advantage for our policymakers, warfighters, intelligence professionals and first responders.
  

  

The Operations Research Analyst provides independent analysis and valuation of select NGA plans, programs, mission, and other enterprise\-wide efforts and initiatives to inform resource decision\-makers or address key concerns of NGA leadership. ORAs lead and support the conduct of statistical analysis (e.g. regression, stochastic) of historical data as an empirical basis for producing independent cost estimates, new analyses of alternatives, or program evaluations. They will collaborate with program, contracting and technical offices in developing scope, baseline, ground rules and assumptions. They will also collaborate with internal Agency, DoD/IC and industry partners to improve program evaluation practices and standards and enhance data collection methods.  

  

Job Description:  

The Operations Research Analyst (ORA) Cost Estimator supports the planning, implementation, and sustainment of systems and/or programs to meet customer requirements by providing cost analysis services. They develop cost estimates and models, conduct feasibility studies and tradeoff analyses, assess risk and schedule, and prepare or evaluate estimates for analysis of alternatives and business cases for planned solutions. They develop rough order\-of\-magnitude estimates for new initiatives/projects and budgetary investment/divestment decisions. They conduct statistical analyses to produce cost estimates, conduct cost research, and provide cost expertise for Agency and community\-wide initiatives.  

  

Duties:  

* Conduct credible and timely cost estimates to support the acquisition process for select programs; enabling internal and external leadership to make informed decisions concerning cost, budget, and schedule
* Conduct data collection, research and analysis to improve the accuracy and reliability of cost estimates
* Build quantitative models to predict the future cost of systems and assess programmatic risks; document results
* Prepare briefings and present cost analysis results to internal and external stakeholders
* Collaborate with IC, DOD, and industry partners on best practices and tradecraft improvement
* Provide leadership and guidance to a team of Cost Analysts

  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**


* US Citizenship is required.
* Designated or Random Drug Testing required.
* Security Investigation

SPECIAL INFO:  

As a condition of employment at NGA, persons being considered for employment must meet NGA fitness for employment standards.
  

  

* U.S. Citizenship

  

\- Security Clearance \- Top Secret /Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI)  

  

* Polygraph \& Drug Test

  

* Direct Deposit

  

* Trial Period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. We may consider: performance conduct; needs and interests of the agency; and whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government and the efficiency of the Federal service

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:  

You must be able to obtain and retain a Top Secret security clearance with access to SCI. In addition, you are subject to a Counterintelligence Polygraph examination in order to maintain access to Top Secret information. All employees are subject to a periodic examination on a random basis in order to determine continued eligibility. Refusal to take the examination may result in denial of access to Top Secret information, SAP, or unescorted access to SCIFs.  

  

Employees with SCI access and who are under NGA cognizance are required to submit a Security Financial Disclosure Report, SF\-714, on an annual basis in order to determine continued eligibility. Failure to comply may negatively impact continued access to Top Secret information, Information Systems, SAP, or unescorted access to SCIFs.

  

NGA utilizes all processes and procedures of the Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel System (DCIPS). Non\-executive NGA employees are assigned to five distinct pay bands based on the type and scope of work performed. The employee's base salary is established within their assigned pay band based on their unique qualifications. A performance pay process is conducted each year to determine a potential base pay salary increase and/or bonus. An employee's annual performance evaluation is a key factor in the performance pay process.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst (f/m/x/d, hybrid set up), Zurich (Zurich, CH)
jobs.description:
**Location:** Zurich, Zurich, CH


Join a team of security and technology professionals and help Swiss Re to fulfil its mission in making the world more resilient.


We're looking for an experienced, forward\-thinking cybersecurity leader who will manage the production of detection content and incident investigation and help us to improve our incident response techniques. As a Cyber Security Analyst, you will be monitoring current threats by analysing and handling major cyber incidents, implementing standards and mentoring less experienced analysts.


What's more, you'll be working in a hybrid setup (50:50\), balancing work from home and the office premises (office presence required 2–3 days per week).


**About The Role**

Group Security \& Technology Platforms (GSTP) brings together security, technology platforms and operational resilience to provide secure, reliable and scalable foundations for Swiss Re's business. The function ensures that security, resilience and engineering quality are embedded by design into how technology is built, operated and evolved across the organisation.


You will be part of the Cyber Defence team – made of passionate individuals who keep the company safe by going above and beyond in terms of preciseness and diligence. We oversee the maintenance of security operations, focusing on delivering high\-quality detection monitoring and response solutions. Our team values innovation, collaboration and continuous learning, providing you with a stimulating environment to grow your expertise and make a tangible impact on our cybersecurity practises.


**In your role, you will perform:**


* Security monitoring – Oversee security operations, use advanced tools to monitor and analyse alerts, proactively detect incidents in real time, investigate and coordinate responses
* Incident response – Investigate security incidents, contain breaches and implement remediation strategies
* Operational excellence – Implement and maintain high operational standards
* Threat intelligence – Stay updated on cybersecurity threats and trends
* On\-call duty – Participate in on\-call rotations to address urgent matters outside of regular working hours
**What we need from you:**


Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of our requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are curious about the world of threat analysis and detection, we'll be more than happy to meet you!


* Experience in cybersecurity as a Security Analyst or Incident Responder (preferably in SOC/CSIRT setup)
* In\-depth knowledge of current threat landscape, offensive tooling and OWASP and industry\-standard security framework, such as MITRE ATT\&CK® techniques and Cyber Kill Chain
* Experience in malware and exploit analysis (or reverse engineering)
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Excellent oral and written communication skills in English
* Effective communication and presentation abilities to articulate and present complex security concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Ability to work well in a fast\-paced environment
**Nice\-to\-have:**


* Experience developing in Python, Kusto or any other scripting language
* Experience with Azure or Amazon AWS
* Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, EDR, DLP solutions

For Switzerland the **base salary range** for this position is between CHF 108,000 and CHF 162,000 (for a full\-time role). The specific salary offered considers:


* the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
* the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.


In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance\-based bonus.


**About Swiss Re**


Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance\-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting\-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  

  

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  

  

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.


We may use AI\-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.description:
**Lead Complex Projects. Deliver Exceptional Results. Grow Your Career.**

These initiatives span intricate renovations, bulk make\-ready/vacant unit turnover, and capital expenditures within the multi\-family sector. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role expertly manages scale—overseeing 25\-40 active projects or multiple recurring contractual properties —as well as strict complexity, including compliance with stringent federal, DOD, or secured\-site regulations.


The Senior Project Manager directs internal teams, subcontractors, and vendors while partnering directly with owners’ representatives, contracting officers, and property managers. Responsibilities span detailed project scheduling, Work\-In\-Progress (WIP) and budget management, safety enforcement, client communication, and proactively identifying change order opportunities to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to exemplary quality standards.

* **Salary Range:** $90,000 \- $100,000
* **Bonus:** 10% annual target bonus (paid quarterly)
* **Auto Allowance \& Reimbursement:** Bi\-weekly fixed contribution \+ monthly variable mileage reimbursement
* **Schedule:** Full\-time

* Strong understanding of construction methods and trades including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, drywall, painting, concrete, and related disciplines.
* Experience building and managing subcontractor networks across multiple trades.
* Knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, estimating, scheduling, and WIP management.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, project scheduling software, and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* High school diploma or GED required; Bachelor's in Construction Management preferred.

* Ability to walk large properties, navigate stairs, and work in outdoor conditions.
* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds.
* Flexibility to work irregular schedules based on business and project needs.

Work hard, grow fast. At MultiPro Property Solutions, we recognize talent, reward ambition, and promote from within. If you’re looking for a place where effort leads to opportunity, innovation is encouraged, and leadership is earned, you’ve found it.

**Comprehensive Benefits:**

* **Financial Security:** 401k with company match, life and disability insurance, AD\&D, and business travel coverage

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Sales Operations Analyst to join our LA based team! This is a graduate\-level opportunity for someone at the start of their career who wants real ownership from day one. If you're a problem\-solving pro, an analytical thinker, a team player and can speak the language of data \- we want to hear from you!

**About ZURU**


ZURU is on a mission to disrupt across industries, challenge the status quo and catalyst change through radical innovation and automation advances. This is in play in different pillars of the company: ZURU Toys are re\-imagining what it means to play; ZURU Tech is shaping a better future by leading the next building revolution; ZURU Edge is pioneering new generation FMCG brands to better serve modern consumers.


Founded in 2003 by EY Entrepreneur of the Year and World Entrepreneur Hall of Fame brothers Nick and Mat Mowbray, ZURU has quickly grown to a team of over 5000 direct and indirect members across more than 30 international locations.


One of the largest toy companies in the world, globally recognized and award\-winning brands include Bunch O Balloons, Mini Brands, XSHOT, Rainbocorns and Smashers. Our global FMCG brands include MONDAY Haircare, Rascals, BONKERS, Gumi Yum Surprise, and more!


For more information, visit www.zuru.com

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Data \& Financial Analysis**

* Provide analytical support for retailer\-level sales performance and proactive SKU management.
* Build weekly, monthly and seasonal forecasts that drive growth and manage excess inventory.
* Maximise POS performance through in\-stock management and End of Selling Period inventory transition.
* Analyse and summarise item and brand performance, publishing your findings and insights to the wider business.
* Prepare ad\-hoc reports in response to business needs.
* Analyse product assortment and child\-level performance to recommend the optimal product mix.
* Research, analyse and publish relevant industry and market trends.
* Build and maintain Profit and Loss statements \- analysing revenue, cost and margin by product, brand, class and category to support informed recommendations.

### **Customer\-Facing Interaction**

* Collaborate with Inventory/Demand Planners and Buyers to optimise inventory management.
* Engage with ZURU's VP of Sales, Commercial, Marketing and Operations teams to keep the business aligned.
* Present sales, operations and financial data to the retailer's team during key meetings.

### **Support**

* Support Sales in Line Review, JBP, forecasting and Buyer's meeting preparation.
* Address requests from Sales, Commercial and Marketing teams regarding POS information.
* Prepare and distribute accurate weekly and monthly POS reports, reviewing them with specific sales teams to surface actionable insights.

### **Design \& Innovation**

* Identify opportunities for improved efficiency and more timely communication of business performance.
* Document key processes and best practices for sharing across teams.
* Map inefficiencies and waste, then propose and implement scalable solutions.

*The annual salary range for this position is $75,000 \- $80,000\.*

*Please note this role is based in\-person in our LA office.*

**What You'll Gain**
--------------------

* Real ownership of retailer\-level analysis from the start \- your forecasts, P\&Ls and insights will be used by senior leaders to make commercial decisions, not filed away.
* Direct exposure to retail customers and to ZURU's Sales, Commercial, Marketing and Operations teams, building the commercial judgement and stakeholder skills that take most analysts years to develop.
* Hands\-on development of your analytical toolkit \- SQL, data visualisation, forecasting and P\&L analysis.
* Exposure to an ever\-expanding and far\-reaching business across a wide variety of sectors and industry groups, giving you a first\-hand view of market practices, challenges and trends, and how data drives decisions across a global business.
* A clear runway to grow. As ZURU is on such a fast growth trajectory, high performers move quickly into broader scope and greater responsibility.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* A recent graduate (or approaching graduation) in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Statistics, Supply Chain, Mathematics or a related field .
* Working knowledge of Excel and SQL, with familiarity across data visualisation, statistical analysis, Python and ETL practices.
* Strong commercial curiosity \- you enjoy working out the "so what" behind the numbers, not just producing them.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present findings to senior stakeholders and external customers.
* Sharp attention to detail and comfort working with large, imperfect datasets.
* A go\-getter with energy, creativity and determination to continuously improve and push boundaries.

**Why ZURU is right for you**


ZURU moves fast, thinks big, and sets ambitious goals. We're not your typical 9\-to\-5\. Our teams are made up of talented people who enjoy solving complex problems, taking ownership, and continuously raising the bar. If you're excited by making a real impact, learning at pace, and being surrounded by people who challenge you to grow, you'll likely thrive at ZURU.

**ZURU's approach to ways of working**


We believe the best ideas come from working closely together. Our teams adopt an office\-first mindset enabling fast collaboration, quicker decision\-making, and stronger team connections. While flexibility may be available depending on the role, location and business needs, most positions are based in the office, where we can innovate, learn from one another, and move quickly as a team.


Get to know us a little better by checking out LIFE@ZURU on Instagram or www.zuru.com

Au sein de la Direction des Opérations de Marchés, Global Infrastructure HSBC Continental Europe, la filière Debt Securities est organisée autour de plusieurs pôles : Delivery Management et Trade Monitoring Group. Cette Filière a la charge de la gestion et du suivi des opérations effectuées par la Salle des Marchés (Markets \& Securities Services Operations).

  

À ce titre, elle joue un rôle fondamental au sein de notre organisation particulièrement en termes de support au développement commercial au travers de la qualité de service à apporter aux clients ainsi que de maîtrise des risques opérationnels. Nous proposons un rôle unique pour aider à jeter les bases de l’amélioration de nos initiatives d’optimisation des coûts.

  

Dans un contexte de marché caractérisé par de l’incertitude, fortement dépendant d’éléments politico\-économiques, de règlementations en perpétuelle évolution, et de pressions concurrentielles grandissantes diminuant les marges, il apparait structurellement nécessaire d’optimiser le facteur Coût en vue de maximiser le résultat, et compte tenu de ces contraintes.

 **Nous recherchons un stagiaire à partir d’Octobre 2026 à temps plein pour 6 mois au 38 Avenue Kléber à Paris.**

 **Mission :**

* Cartographier les coûts liés aux opérations de marché avec précision et granularité.
* Définir des critères quantitatifs et qualitatifs à analyser pour optimiser les processus.
* Développer un outil d’analyse statistique et empirique pour automatiser les rapports et soutenir la prise de décision.
* Identifier les corrélations entre différents critères à l’aide de méthodes statistiques (régression, covariance, élasticité).
* Optimiser les stratégies de réduction des coûts en modélisant des fonctions de profit et de coût sous contraintes.

Mettre en œuvre un plan d’action en budgétisant les solutions et en suivant leur impact sur le PnL.

* Solides compétences mathématiques, statistiques,
* Vous maîtrisez Visual Basic, Excel et SQL

* Vous parlez couramment anglais
* Autonomie, rigueur, réactivité, disponibilité

  

Même si vous ne remplissez pas 100% des critères, nous vous encourageons à candidater si vous pensez que le rôle est fait pour vous !

 **Pourquoi rejoindre HSBC ?**

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, New Verticals
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



At DoorDash we're building the industry's most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three\-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services as well as the engineers building these services. It's no simple task, but it wouldn't be interesting if it was!


**About the Role**
------------------



New Verticals is building the future of local commerce at DoorDash: making the city shoppable by helping consumers get groceries, convenience items, retail products, and more with the quality, speed, and affordability they expect. The organization operates at significant scale and is expanding beyond the core marketplace into new fulfillment models and merchant\-facing products. Our work spans the consumer shopping experience, catalog and inventory, pricing and affordability, fulfillment, merchant integrations, and the platform capabilities that connect them.



Our team is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to lead complex, high\-impact programs across New Verticals Engineering. This role sits at the intersection of product, platform, and operations, helping translate ambitious business bets into executable technical strategies. You will work across Grocery, Convenience, Retail, DashMart Fulfillment Services, and emerging Merchant Services initiatives, where success requires navigating deeply interconnected systems, evolving product requirements, and dependencies across multiple DoorDash organizations. You will bring strong technical judgment, create clarity in ambiguous spaces, identify risks before they become blockers, and drive programs from strategy through launch and scale.



You will report into the centralized Technical Program Management team in Engineering. You must be located in either the San Francisco Bay Area or Seattle.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* **Drive New Verticals' Most Strategic Programs \-** You will partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership, Strategy \& Operations, and cross\-functional teams to turn New Verticals' strategy into executable technical programs. The portfolio spans growing Grocery and Convenience, scaling Retail selection and shopping experiences, evolving DashMart Fulfillment Services, and building new Merchant Services capabilities.
* **Lead Complex Cross\-Organization Execution \-** New Verticals depends on capabilities across consumer experience, catalog and inventory, pricing and promotions, logistics, merchant integrations, ads, and platform infrastructure. You will establish clear ownership and milestones, surface critical dependencies and tradeoffs, and drive alignment across teams when the path forward is not obvious.
* **Bring Technical Depth and Systems Thinking** \- You will develop a deep understanding of the architecture, data flows, and operational systems behind New Verticals. You will engage in technical designs, identify scaling and reliability risks, understand how decisions in one part of the system affect the end\-to\-end customer and merchant experience, and help teams make pragmatic tradeoffs.
* **Turn Ambiguity into Strategy and Action** \- Many of our hardest problems do not begin with a clean scope or a single owner. You will truth\-seek across technical and business inputs, frame the problem, clarify the definition of success, develop a point of view on risks and options, and create an execution path that teams and leaders can align behind.
* **Connect Engineering Execution to Business Outcomes \-** You will understand the customer, merchant, and economic outcomes behind the work and use that context to guide prioritization and execution. Whether the goal is improving speed and quality, expanding selection, making shopping easier, or improving cost to serve, you will help teams stay focused on the technical work that matters most to the business.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You're experienced in working with large\-scale distributed systems, as well as client\-side and platform teams, who own Tier 0 services serving external customers. You can speak to system architecture, scalability and reliability decisions, and design trade offs.
* You're a strong leader with the ability to collaborate and build relationships across organizations, bridge gaps between teams, and successfully influence without authority.
* You have strong ownership, urgency, and drive. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and dive into the details to understand and drive your programs.
* You have excellent written \& verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with confidence, clarity, and focus. You can convey concepts and considerations to non\-experts and experts alike.
* You've engaged with Engineering teams on product \& platform development with a thorough understanding of software development processes and project planning.
* You are pragmatic and detailed in your approach and focus on progress, not perfection.


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's Degree with experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering or other related discipline.
* 8\+ years recent experience as a Technical Program Manager at a technology company.
* Experience in large\-scale distributed systems and system architecture.
* Experience working with full\-stack engineers and directly engaging on product development, with a thorough understanding of software development processes.
* Project planning and execution skills that include reviewing technical design documents, estimating, and scheduling.

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year


Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Austin, TX, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Addison, TX, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience with data analysis, bug fixing, and utilizing tracking tools such as business intelligence platform and bug dashboards to resolve operational issues.
* Experience in technical program management, requirements gathering, and stakeholder management related to physical security systems, compliance, and data center architecture.
* Experience utilizing Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage preventative maintenance and workflow automation.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience mapping electronic security systems to security controls.
* Experience maintaining technology in security environments.
* Experience maintaining and upgrading one or more of the following systems: access Control, badging and credential technology, Identity and PAM, video surveillance, high security intrusion detection, physical security networking, physical security servers and infrastructure.
* Experience leading and managing technology projects in all phases, from evaluation to design and execution.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


The CSRM\-Technical Operations Safety Platforms, Architectures and Concept Engineering (SPACE) team is looking for an innovative and technically\-driven Technical Program Manager to join our team sustaining the electronic security and safety systems in our data center fleet. You will get to exercise all your physical security systems expertise, and system administration knowledge to make Google data centers a safer and more operationally sound place to work.


In this role, you will own the logical administration, remote maintenance strategy, and lifecycle standards of physical security devices across our entire data center fleet. You will architect global lifecycle and firmware maintenance programs and drive remote support performance to ensure zero operational downtime. By leveraging health telemetry and building strong cross\-functional partnerships, you will directly influence how our physical security systems are maintained and secured while reducing the fleet’s overall risk profile.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $163000 \- $236000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Engage with cross\-functional teams (site operations, compliance, and engineering) to optimize logical configurations and platform integrity for physical security systems, streamlining remote programming and change management.
* Drive global standardization of system programming, configuration settings, and diagnostic workflows for physical security infrastructure (e.g., access control, CCTV) to ensure consistent remote commissioning and breakfix execution.
* Develop and monitor performance KPIs for system uptime and resolution efficiency, while designing telemetry dashboards to enhance remote diagnostic tools and provide real\-time visibility into device health.
* Architect and manage a remote support SLA framework, holding internal support tiers and third\-party integration partners to strict Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) and quality\-of\-repair targets globally.
* Lead technical root\-cause analysis (RCA) for major system outages by leveraging device event logs, network packet captures, and telemetry data to prevent repeat incidents and address systemic vulnerabilities.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will drive structure and coordination for large\-scale, complex engineering initiatives that power the bedrock of the platform\-from core service layers to data infrastructure that supports millions of real\-time transactions. * Apply technical acumen and strategic program management principles to establish the initial framework for success, focusing on rapid value delivery and organizational change readiness.
* Develop and track KPIs and success metrics to measure the effectiveness, business value, and organizational impact of GenAI programs, and regularly report insights to leadership.
* Optimize cross\-team processes and workflows to improve operational efficiency, stakeholder alignment, and delivery outcomes for AI\-related initiatives.

	+ Supporting AI enablement initiatives, including foundational planning, stakeholder alignment, governance strategy development, and operational readiness for large\-scale technology adoption;
	+ Process optimization and operational excellence, including identifying inefficiencies and designing scalable processes to improve delivery, adoption, and organizational effectiveness;

The Senior Program Manager, M\&A is a high\-impact, leadership role that serves as a **principal architect of the M\&A People strategy and operational methodology** . You will move beyond managing individual transactions to leading a portfolio of complex, high\-stakes integrations and owning the scalability of the entire People M\&A function. This role requires deep People domain expertise, a strategic planning mindset, and the proven ability to influence senior leaders and navigate significant global ambiguity. You have to be comfortable pushing back on the business and other key stakeholders. You will be accountable for defining success metrics, managing execution risk across multiple jurisdictions, and ensuring the M\&A process delivers a world\-class employee experience.
  

  

**What You'll Do**
* **Lead and govern a portfolio** of concurrent, high\-stakes M\&A transactions, accountable for end\-to\-end People workstream execution across multiple, often conflicting, global legal and regulatory frameworks.
* **Spearhead the resolution** of highly ambiguous and structurally complex integration challenges, including global compensation harmonization, collective bargaining/labor council negotiation strategy, complex HRIS data migration, and global mobility issues.
* **Drive rigorous due diligence** processes, synthesizing complex legal, HR, and cultural data into clear, actionable recommendations for deal structuring and risk mitigation.
* **Develop and maintain robust, high\-trust cross\-functional partnerships** with Corporate Development, Legal, Finance, and IT/Systems teams to ensure seamless data and operational integration.

**About Vantage Data Centers**
==============================

  

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Reliability Engineering**


The Reliability Engineering Department is responsible for ensuring the operational health of critical systems and the implementation of Site Operations best practices. This includes evaluating the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure, maintaining operational availability through maintenance programs, and providing technical support to Site Operations teams. The department also collaborates closely with the Design Engineering team to provide feedback for future data center designs.

**Position Overview**

**This role will be based near any of our North America office locations, following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

The Sr. Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment \- Electrical Design Assurance is responsible for providing operationally focused electrical review and technical assurance for new data center builds, expansions, and major fit\-out projects across the North America portfolio. This role represents Site Operations and Site Deployment during design development, page\-turn reviews, submittal reviews, RFI responses, commissioning strategy alignment, and movement of design packages toward Issued for Construction drawings.


The position ensures that electrical systems are designed and delivered in a manner that is operable, maintainable, safe, reliable, and aligned with long\-term Mission Critical Operations requirements. Working closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and local Site Operations teams, this role brings operator perspective into electrical design decisions before construction execution, procurement, and turnover activities create downstream operational risk.

* Review electrical submittals, equipment selections, vendor documentation, and proposed alternates to evaluate operational impact, maintainability requirements, protection strategy, and lifecycle risk.
* Support responses to RFIs related to electrical distribution, equipment access, switching, redundancy, load management, protection coordination, EPMS interfaces, maintenance clearances, and long\-term serviceability.
* Evaluate value engineering proposals and design changes to ensure critical operational requirements are not removed, reduced, or compromised without appropriate risk visibility.

* Review MEP coordination impacts where electrical systems interface with mechanical, controls, fire protection, security, architectural, structural, civil, and utility scopes.

jobs.title: Environmental Markets Program Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about decarbonization and combating climate change? As Project Manager on Apple's Environmental Initiatives team, you will manage and drive decarbonization of Apple’s product manufacturing at scale through engagement with environmental markets.  

  

In this role you will be part of a nimble global Operations team and will be a key contributor to Apple's strategy for supply chain decarbonization, supporting investment opportunities, market transactions and credit management for renewable energy, nature based solutions and beyond.  

  

You will partner closely with Apple Operations, Finance and Procurement leadership to support and guide transactions in renewable energy and carbon markets to help grow carbon neutral pathways for Apple and its supply chain partners.  

  

**Description**  

  

This dynamic role works within the Environmental Initiatives team to achieve renewable energy targets and carbon credit procurement (e.g. MWhs, MMT C02e, date online, location, etc.), support the associated project/deal pipeline and portfolio, and support sourcing and managing the environmental attribute credits (EACs) and the broader portfolio management. Cross functional collaboration is needed as the role will interact with finance, tax and accounting, legal, procurement, and government affairs.  

  

You will work closely with subject matter experts in renewable energy deals and carbon markets to support deal development, transactions and fulfillment. Key tasks include managing the portfolio assets (ex: EACs or credits), and the associated registries where credits are housed; tracking and preparing reports on portfolio status for the team and for management; supporting due diligence on potential transaction partners or service providers; and supporting access to high\-quality carbon credits for our supply chain actors.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Experience in project finance or business development a plus  

  

Experience in managing cross\-functional stakeholders, negotiating strategic partnerships, and identifying high\-quality investment opportunities that deliver both financial returns and measurable climate impact is a plus  

  

Familiarity with voluntary and/or compliance carbon markets and related quality standards and policy (ex: GHGP, ICVCM, SBTi) is helpful  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

5\+ years of supporting corporations with the provision of renewable energy and/or emission reduction solutions (ex: in voluntary carbon markets) for fulfillment of compliance or voluntary objectives  

  

Familiarity with environmental attribute certificates in energy and carbo  

  

Collaborative team player. Ready to roll up sleeves, as needed, to support several projects and programs  

  

Strong communicator, able to convey difficult topics in simple terms and get to the heart of matters  

  

Occasional travel as needed  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $163,500 and $246,200, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

GM is seeking an **Autonomous Vehicle Safety Assurance Technical Program Manager** to lead integrated execution across the SAFE\-ADS operating plan.


This staff individual contributor will bring structure, momentum, and transparency to technically complex workstreams spanning safety risk management, operational safety, human factors, software validation, safety metrics, rules\-of\-the\-road compliance, counterfactual simulation, and related system\-safety interfaces.


The successful candidate will connect strategy to delivery by translating operating\-plan objectives into actionable roadmaps, aligning cross\-functional teams to milestones and measurable outcomes, managing technical dependencies and risks, and driving decisions to closure across engineering, validation, data, operations, legal, public policy, and product organizations.


This role is ideal for an experienced technical program leader who can operate at both the systems level and in execution details, communicate effectively with technical and executive audiences, and improve the processes and tools used to deliver safety\-critical software and assurance programs.

Program Execution


* Own the integrated execution model for SAFE\-ADS operating\-plan initiatives, including objectives , milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, decisions, and deliverables.
* Translate product requirements, program milestones, and operating \-plan commitments into clear workstream charters, roadmaps, delivery plans, and ownership models.
* Coordinate planning\-cycle updates and ensure changes to scope, priorities, dependencies, and capacity are reflected across relevant plans.
* Establish governance, status reporting, action tracking, decision logs, escalation paths, and program reviews that keep execution visible and predictable.
* Drive risk mitigation and recovery plans, escalating technical, schedule, resource, and dependency issues with decision\-ready recommendations.
* Partner with engineering, operations, quality, Legal, and GPSSC stakeholders on incident response, investigations, corrective actions, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.
* Improve workflows, dashboards, automations, and data quality across Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, SharePoint , requirements tools, and related systems.
Safety Assurance


* Manage dependencies among human\-factors studies, operational data, safety requirements, validation criteria, readiness assessments, and program milestones.

new_jobs.title: Transmission Planning Project Manager - 1898 & Co.
new_jobs.description:
**Description**


At 1898 \& Co., we are helping shape the future of transmission systems across North America. Our Transmission Planning and Power Systems Analysis team works with a diverse mix of clients—investor\-owned utilities, public power entities, developers, and ISOs/RTOs—to deliver smart, resilient, and future\-ready electric grid solutions. As part of Burns \& McDonnell, we bring together decades of experience, a deep bench of technical talent, and a spirit of innovation to solve some of the most critical infrastructure challenges of our time. We're looking for a Transmission Planning Project Manager who brings a strong mix of technical knowledge and leadership capability. This is a high\-impact role for someone passionate about solving complex power system problems, developing teams, and working directly with clients on critical planning studies and system improvements. Are you ready to help drive the energy transition forward?


**What You’ll Do**


As a Transmission Planning Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all phases of transmission planning projects, from business development through execution. You will manage multidisciplinary teams, develop scope and fee structures, ensure quality deliverables, and maintain strong client relationships. You’ll also be a mentor and resource for growing talent within our team. Key responsibilities include:


Business Development


* Cultivate and grow client relationships through marketing efforts, project interactions, and strategic engagement.
* Identify and pursue new sales opportunities with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and developers.
* Lead proposal development, project scoping, budgeting, and scheduling activities.
* Set critical project objectives with clients and lead contract development and negotiations.

Project Execution


* Manage the full lifecycle of transmission planning projects including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client communication.
* Lead risk assessment processes and procedures using industry best practices.
* Direct and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams of engineers and analysts.
* Communicate project status, risks, and costs to stakeholders and executive leadership.

Leadership \& Mentorship


* Train and mentor junior staff on both technical and project management aspects of transmission planning.
* Champion internal initiatives that promote team growth and technical excellence.
* Serve as a go\-to technical expert in transmission system planning and evaluation.

Technical Responsibilities


* Perform and lead advanced transmission planning studies, including steady\-state, transient stability, short circuit, voltage analysis, and production costing.
* Apply and interpret regulatory standards (NERC, FERC, and regional policies) to ensure compliant and forward\-thinking planning.
* Utilize tools like PSS®E, PSLF, PowerWorld, PSCAD, EMTP/ATP, ETAP, and Promod to perform complex power system modeling and analysis.
* Resolve technical challenges related to transmission planning and present clear, actionable solutions to project stakeholders.

**Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, computer science or related field from an accredited program and 5 years of related professional experience.
* Knowledge in project management, techniques, and procedures.
* Excellent computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong organizational skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Experience leading technical aspects of consulting engagements in regards to power systems, distribution planning, and grid modernization.
* Experience on consulting projects, client operations, or executing program management within the critical infrastructure industry.
* Understanding of general business and financial principles.
* Experience with communicating across business segments to understand project objectives.

**Compensation**


$140,000\.00\-375,000\.00 Yearly


The expected compensation range for this position is displayed in compliance with all local/state regulations. The expected compensation range for this position is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to: individual education, qualifications, prior work experience and work location. The total annual compensation package will consist of a base salary and eligibility to participate in our discretionary year\-end incentive bonus program.


**Benefits**


Our extensive benefits package takes care of you so that you can focus on doing great work. From insurance and disability to time off and wellness programs, we provide the tools to meet your needs. As part of being 100% employee\-owned, eligible employees participate in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) in addition to our 401(k) retirement program. For more information, please visit the Benefits \& Wellness page.


This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

SECURITY OPERATIONS MANAGER  

We are excited to invite a passionate and experienced Security Operations Manager to join our team! Homes for the Homeless (HFH) is searching for a Security Operations Manager for our Families w/ Children facility in the Williamsbridge area of the Bronx, NY. As the Security Operations Manager, you will play a pivotal role in our organization, overseeing the performance of our dedicated Safety Aides in ensuring a collaborative and supportive environment, where our team can excel and provide the best safety to our families. Join us and be a part of an organization that values your contribution and cares deeply for the community we serve.  

ABOUT HOMES FOR THE HOMELESS:
Homes for the Homeless operates shelters for families experiencing homelessness in NYC. Our family residences are more than just a place to sleep. Families can make the most of their stay through accessing an array of onsite programs. Many of these programs are also available to people living in the local community. Our goal is to have a positive impact so families can thrive long after they leave our shelters.  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:* Manage and supervise assigned shift staff.
* Ensures compliance with security and FDNY protocols, reports, and regulations.
* The ability to train staff on protocols and procedures, as well as proper use of equipment.
* Comfortable with conducting workshops for staff.
* Train staff on incident report writing.
* Keep all critical files up to date.
* Strong administrative skills.
* Respond to emergency situations.

* **F\-02 Certification required.**
* **F\-80 Certification required.**
* T\-89 Fire and Life Safety Director (FLSD) Certification preferred.

* A minimum of five (5\) years of experience with at least one (1\) year of supervisory experience in a similar position.

* Working knowledge, operating surveillance camera systems and related technology.
* The ability to stand, sit and walk for an extended period of time.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
