new_jobs.description:
**About Us:**

  

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

  

**Exciting Opportunity at MSK:** Project Manager, Capital Procurement (Planning, Design \+ Construction)


The Project Manager, Capital Procurement supports Planning, Design \& Construction’s capital project portfolio by developing procurement strategies, coordinating complex sourcing activities, and improving the processes, tools, and reporting used to procure design, construction, consulting, FF\&E, equipment, and related capital\-project goods and services.

  

  

The position serves as PD\&C’s primary operational liaison to Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Real Estate Operations, Equipment Planning, and other institutional partners. The Project Manager coordinates procurement activities from early planning and scope development through solicitation, evaluation, recommendation, award, and transition to contract and purchase\-order administration.


The role works in accordance with MSK procurement policies, contracting requirements, financial controls, and delegated authority, while helping project teams execute procurements consistently, efficiently, and transparently.


**Role Overview**
-----------------


* Develop and manage project\-specific procurement plans aligned with approved scope, budget, schedule, operational requirements, and project delivery strategies.
* Coordinate procurement activities across the full lifecycle, from planning and solicitation through award, contract execution, and purchase\-order administration.
* Support competitive sourcing events including RFPs, RFQs, bidder selection, evaluation processes, interviews, bid leveling, and recommendation development.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and project teams to execute procurement activities efficiently and consistently.
* Monitor procurement milestones, contracts, requisitions, supplier commitments, and long\-lead items to support project schedules and operational readiness.
* Recommend procurement strategies that promote value, competition, quality, risk management, and schedule performance across capital projects.
* Serve as a key advisor to project teams on procurement pathways, documentation requirements, supplier availability, lead times, and market conditions.
* Support supplier performance management by tracking responsiveness, quality, schedule adherence, and issue resolution in collaboration with Strategic Sourcing.
* Maintain procurement dashboards, reporting, risk assessments, and performance metrics while identifying opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization.

**Key Qualifications**
----------------------


* Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, project management, construction, or capital project delivery.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex competitive procurements, sourcing initiatives, or contract award processes.
* Experience procuring consultant services, construction services, FF\&E, capital equipment, or other capital project\-related goods and services; healthcare or institutional construction experience preferred.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and enterprise procurement, ERP, project management, or project controls systems.
* Professional certifications such as CPSM, C.P.M., PMP, CCM, or comparable credentials preferred.

**Core Skills**
---------------


* Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with diverse stakeholders while driving cross\-functional collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret procurement, financial, supplier, and project performance data.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, and presentation skills for influencing decisions and managing complex initiatives.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple concurrent projects and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**WHY JOIN AGU**  

Our employees are our most valuable assets! You will feel welcomed and supported from the moment you join our team, and you will take part in strengthening and evolving our workplace culture.  

We offer work\-life balance and innovative benefits.* Work\-life balance: remote\-first organization, flexible work hours, unlimited PTO, Flexible Fridays, paid holidays, military leave, parental leave.
* Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life Insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, wellness, tuition reimbursement, 403(b) retirement plan, FSA, HSA, theft protection, personal and professional development, and much more.

**WHO WE ARE**  

The American Geophysical Union (AGU) supports a global community of more than half a million professionals and advocates in the Earth and space sciences.  

Through broad and inclusive partnerships, AGU aims to advance discovery and solution science that accelerates knowledge and creates solutions that are ethical, unbiased, and respectful of communities and their values. Our programs include serving as a scholarly publisher, convening virtual and in\-person events, and providing career support. We live our values in everything we do, such as our net\-zero energy renovated building in Washington, D.C., and our Ethics and Equity Center, which fosters a diverse and inclusive geoscience community to ensure responsible conduct.
This is an exciting time to work at AGU. Every day we approach our work with a sense of purpose, and we look for others who share that passion and desire for a career with impact.**WHO YOU ARE**
As the Project Manager you will support AGU’s mission to advance Earth and space sciences for the benefit of humanity by planning and delivering projects that meet established scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance expectations.
You are responsible for coordinating the execution, implementation, and completion of assigned projects. This includes developing project plans, establishing timelines and budgets, identifying resource needs, tracking progress, managing risks and issues, and coordinating the work of cross\-functional team members, vendors, and consultants. The Project Manager ensures that project activities remain aligned with organizational priorities and that changes to scope, schedule, or budget are appropriately evaluated, documented, and communicated.
Working collaboratively with project sponsors, customers, and other stakeholders, the Project Manager helps define project objectives, requirements, deliverables, roles, and measures of success. The position facilitates meetings, maintains project documentation, prepares status reports, supports informed decision\-making, and escalates significant risks or barriers when necessary.
You will receive general direction and applies established project management practices, policies, and procedures to assigned work. Success in this role requires strong organizational, analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills; sound judgment; attention to detail; and the ability to build productive working relationships, manage competing priorities, and guide teams toward successful project outcomes.**WHAT YOU WILL DO**  

Manage assigned projects from initiation through completion, applying established PMO processes, tools, and project management practices.* Collaborate with project sponsors, customers, and cross\-functional teams to define project scope, objectives, success criteria, requirements, and deliverables.
* Identify project stakeholders and develops appropriate communication and engagement approaches to keep them informed and involved throughout the project lifecycle.
* Work with sponsors, team members, contractors, and consultants to develop project deliverables, resource requirements, work plans, budgets, schedules, and measures of success.
* Develop and maintains project plans, schedules, budgets, communication plans, risk registers, decision logs, status reports, and other required project documentation.
* Organize and coordinates project activities, meetings, dependencies, and deliverables to support timely and effective execution.
* Monitor project budgets, forecasts expenses, reviews financial performance, and communicates potential budget variances to the project sponsor and appropriate leadership.
* Identify project resource needs and works with functional managers and project sponsors to secure the staff, contractors, consultants, and other resources required for successful delivery.
* Coordinate the work of cross\-functional project teams, contractors, and consultants, ensuring that roles, responsibilities, expectations, and deadlines are clearly understood.
* Establish an appropriate schedule and format for project status reporting and provides clear, accurate, and timely updates on progress, accomplishments, risks, issues, decisions, budgets, and upcoming activities.
* Monitor project progress against established scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance requirements and takes corrective action when necessary.
* Identify, documents, tracks, and supports the resolution of project risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and barriers, escalating significant concerns when appropriate.
* Manage proposed changes to project scope, schedule, budget, resources, or deliverables through established change\-control processes.
* Develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans to reduce the potential impact of project risks and unexpected challenges.
* Assign and coordinates project tasks, follows up on commitments, and promotes accountability among project team members while recognizing that functional managers retain responsibility for employee supervision and performance management.
* Facilitate productive project meetings and discussions, helping teams resolve conflicts, make decisions, and maintain progress toward agreed\-upon outcomes.
* Build collaborative working relationships with project sponsors, team members, customers

new_jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment - Electrical Design Assurance, NA
new_jobs.description:
**About Vantage Data Centers**
==============================

  

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Reliability Engineering**


The Reliability Engineering Department is responsible for ensuring the operational health of critical systems and the implementation of Site Operations best practices. This includes evaluating the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure, maintaining operational availability through maintenance programs, and providing technical support to Site Operations teams. The department also collaborates closely with the Design Engineering team to provide feedback for future data center designs.

**Position Overview**

**This role will be based near any of our North America office locations, following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

The Sr. Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment \- Electrical Design Assurance is responsible for providing operationally focused electrical review and technical assurance for new data center builds, expansions, and major fit\-out projects across the North America portfolio. This role represents Site Operations and Site Deployment during design development, page\-turn reviews, submittal reviews, RFI responses, commissioning strategy alignment, and movement of design packages toward Issued for Construction drawings.


The position ensures that electrical systems are designed and delivered in a manner that is operable, maintainable, safe, reliable, and aligned with long\-term Mission Critical Operations requirements. Working closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and local Site Operations teams, this role brings operator perspective into electrical design decisions before construction execution, procurement, and turnover activities create downstream operational risk.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Serve as the primary Site Deployment representative for electrical design assurance across assigned campuses, projects, and expansions.
* Participate in design page\-turn reviews and provide operator\-focused comments from concept design through IFC drawing issuance.
* Review electrical design packages, one\-line diagrams, specifications, sequences of operation, equipment schedules, load studies, and drawing sets for operability, maintainability, safety, and reliability.
* Review electrical submittals, equipment selections, vendor documentation, and proposed alternates to evaluate operational impact, maintainability requirements, protection strategy, and lifecycle risk.
* Support responses to RFIs related to electrical distribution, equipment access, switching, redundancy, load management, protection coordination, EPMS interfaces, maintenance clearances, and long\-term serviceability.
* Evaluate value engineering proposals and design changes to ensure critical operational requirements are not removed, reduced, or compromised without appropriate risk visibility.
* Provide technical input for electrical commissioning strategies, operational acceptance criteria, test scripts, integrated systems testing, energization plans, and turnover readiness expectations.
* Collaborate with Site Deployment TPMs and future MCO teams to ensure electrical design intent is carried forward into construction, commissioning, training, CMMS population, and steady\-state operations.
* Capture lessons learned from active operating sites and deployment projects and feed them back into future electrical design standards, templates, and review criteria.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review electrical design milestones including 30%, 60%, 90%, IFC, bulletin, and construction revision packages.
* Assess utility service arrangements, medium\-voltage distribution, low\-voltage distribution, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, generators, fuel systems interfaces, transfer schemes, busways, panels, grounding, lightning protection, batteries, and EPMS architecture.
* Validate maintenance access, equipment clearances, working space, switching paths, isolation strategy, arc flash considerations, labeling, redundancy philosophy, and operational workflows within electrical spaces.
* Track design review comments, assigned actions, and open electrical issues through closure with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Site Operations stakeholders.
* Participate in recurring design coordination meetings, page turns, constructability reviews, operability reviews, energization planning, and commissioning planning sessions.
* Review MEP coordination impacts where electrical systems interface with mechanical, controls, fire protection, security, architectural, structural, civil, and utility scopes.
* Provide operator perspective on sequence of operations, switching procedures, alarm strategy, metering, trending capability, EPMS points, electrical safety requirements, and emergency operating scenarios.
* Review proposed equipment substitutions or manufacturer deviations for potential impacts to maintainability, spare parts, training, warranty, resilience, and operational standardization.
* Support development of operational design standards, electrical review checklists, lessons learned repositories, and acceptance criteria used by the Site Deployment organization.
* Partner with local MCO leadership to ensure future operators understand electrical design intent, operating limitations, maintenance requirements, and known risk items prior to turnover.

**Job Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in data center operations, electrical engineering, commissioning, critical facilities maintenan

new_jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**


Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **About The Role**


Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected. We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission\-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.


At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission you’ll define it. Lead the work that keeps America flying safely.

  

At Peraton, we don’t just manage projects—we deliver the systems that protect and advance U.S. air travel. We are seeking a **Technical Project Manager \- Senior** to lead complex, high\-visibility engineering and technology initiatives supporting the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This role sits at the heart of aviation modernization, where disciplined execution, technical excellence, and mission impact converge. If you thrive in environments where precision matters, collaboration is essential, and your work has national significance, this role offers both challenge and purpose.

  

**Work Location:**


* This position is required to be on\-site, primarily located in Herndon, VA, with an alternate work location available in Bowie, MD. Candidates must be able to work on\-site at one of these locations based on program requirements.

**In this position, you will:**

  

**Program Execution**


* Own the full lifecycle of sophisticated network, infrastructure, and software projects—from concept through deployment.
* Translate complex engineering requirements into executable plans, schedules, and budgets using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.
* Align technical delivery with long\-term FAA modernization goals and program priorities.
* Support requirements analysis, system testing, readiness reviews, and operational transitions.
* Champion continuous improvement, bringing structure, consistency, and efficiency to complex engineering efforts.
* Drive projects to successful completion while meeting FAA standards, cost targets, and delivery commitments.

**Technical Leadership \& Collaboration**


* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional teams spanning software, hardware, networking, RAN, and systems integration.
* Partner closely with vendors, engineers, and program leaders to ensure seamless execution across all technical domains.
* Provide clear, confident briefings and milestone updates to FAA and senior program stakeholders.

**Risk Management with Real Impact**


* Anticipate and resolve technical risks, dependencies, and integration challenges—especially within network and infrastructure deployments.
* Ensure issues are identified early and addressed decisively to protect mission outcomes.

**Trusted Stakeholder Partner**


* Serve as the primary bridge between technical teams, program management, and FAA leadership.
* Maintain transparent communication and strong relationships that enable informed decisions and sustained confidence.
  

**Why You’ll Want This Role:**

  

Few roles offer the opportunity to apply deep technical and project management expertise at a scale that truly matters. In this position, your leadership directly supports aviation safety, cybersecurity, and infrastructure modernization across the National Airspace System.

  

**Your work will:**

  

* Influence systems relied upon by millions of travelers every day
* Support FAA initiatives that enhance safety, capacity, and resilience
* Place you at the center of high\-profile, mission\-critical programs
##### **Qualifications**


**Required Qualifications:**


* U.S. Citizenship Required.
* Must have the ability to obtain / maintain a Public Trust clearance.
* 10 years of relevant experience
* Demonstrated success managing technical, engineering, or IT infrastructure projects.
* Hands\-on Network Engineering, Cybersecurity or Software Testing experience.
* Strong understanding of project management principles, risk management, and performance tracking.
* Proven ability to manage project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, and dependencies using structured project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience briefing senior leadership and external customers.
* Hands\-on experience with risk identification, mitigation, and issue resolution in technical project environments.
* Proven ability to develop and manage detailed project schedules and budgets.
* Ability to conduct technical reviews, validation activities, and post\-implementation assessments.
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Exposure to FAA programs or NAS systems.
* Experience supporting FAA NextGen, air traffic management systems, or federal technology modernization efforts.
* Degree in Engineering Management, Business Administration (M

new_jobs.title: Cybersecurity Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
  
  

ASRC Federal Data Networx is seeking a Cybersecurity Program Manager to oversee federal cybersecurity program.
  
**Work Location:** Remote
  
Key Responsibilities
  
* Serve as the primary cybersecurity and privacy advisor to System Owners for assigned systems.
* Lead RMF activities, including development and maintenance of System Security and Privacy Plans (SSPPs), authorization packages, risk documentation, and supporting artifacts.
* Ensure systems maintain Authorization to Operate (ATO) through assessment support, continuous monitoring, and compliance with NIST RMF, FISMA, and federal security requirements.
* Assess security risks, validate security controls, and coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA\&Ms).
* Maintain system inventories, security documentation, contingency plans, configuration management plans, and privacy documentation.
* Collaborate with ISSMs, System Owners, Security Control Assessors, and technical teams to integrate security throughout the system lifecycle.
* Monitor system security posture, review vulnerability and compliance scan results, and support continuous authorization initiatives.
* Provide cybersecurity guidance, develop security policies and procedures, and deliver security awareness training.
* Support security engineering, certification and accreditation activities, and implementation of security controls across systems.
* Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to enhance RMF and cybersecurity operations.
* Perform independent quality assurance reviews of program performance and deliverables to ensure that contractual obligations are being met.


Required Qualifications
  
* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–7 years of experience supporting information assurance, cybersecurity, RMF, or information system security, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience supporting federal cybersecurity programs and the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF).
* Experience developing and maintaining RMF documentation, authorization packages, and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tools.
* Strong knowledge of NIST SP 800\-37, NIST SP 800\-53, FISMA, FIPS 199, and federal privacy requirements.
* Experience supporting Authorization to Operate (ATO), Continuous ATO (cATO), or Continuous Authorization efforts.
* Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Expertise in cybersecurity processes and protection of technical architecture.


Required Certifications
  
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance (CGRC) or Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)


Preferred Qualifications
  
* Experience supporting U.S. federal civilian agencies, preferably the USPTO.
* Experience with continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and security automation.
* Familiarity with cloud security, DevSecOps, and continuous authorization initiatives.
* Knowledge of privacy compliance activities, including Privacy Threshold Assessments (PTAs), Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and System of Records Notices (SORNs).

new_jobs.description:
**IT Program Manager (TRIRIGA / Maximo)**


**Location:** Washington, DC Metro Area (Hybrid)


Metric5 is seeking an **IT Program Manager** with expertise in enterprise system implementations (TRIRIGA/Maximo preferred) to lead the day\-to\-day execution of an upcoming Department of Homeland Security (DHS) project managing real property and logistics assets.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Program \& Project Execution:** Serve as the primary operational leader responsible for the day\-to\-day execution of the project lifecycle. Manage projects varying in size, complexity, delivery type (new builds, existing systems, or transitions from another provider), and life cycle phases using Agile methodologies.
* **Agile Artifact Delivery:** Manage cross\-functional Agile delivery teams to produce key development artifacts, including Sprint/Product/Release Backlogs, Burn\-down/up charts, and Team Velocity metrics.
* **Schedule \& Budget Management:** Develop and manage project performance and integrated schedules using MS Project, Jira, and Confluence, ensuring complete transparency into schedule and budget status.
* **Risk Management:** Proactively identify, prioritize, and mitigate technical and operational risks; communicate and escalate issues to stakeholders as needed.

This is a temporary remote position starting mid\-September 2026 and ending mid\-January 2027\. This position focuses on geopolitical risk, global threat intelligence, and monitoring events that could disrupt client operations, including political, economic, social, and security factors, as well as natural events such as severe weather and other disasters. new_jobs.title: Cloud Threat Analyst
new_jobs.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
  
  

ASRC Federal is hiring a Cloud Threat Analyst in support of our Defense Counterintelligence Security Agency (DCSA) program based out of Hanover MD.

**Position Description:**  

As the Cloud Threat Analyst, your primary duty is to safeguard our national security systems through proactive threat hunting and advanced threat detection activities. You will continuously monitor and analyze threat intelligence sources to stay informed about emerging threats, searching for signs of malicious activity across our network infrastructure, endpoints, and systems that evade traditional security solutions. A key part of your role involves developing and implementing new and innovative threat detection techniques and strategies, analyzing large datasets to identify patterns and anomalies indicative of malicious activities, and mapping adversary tactics to the MITRE ATT\&CK framework. You will collaborate with other CSOC team members and stakeholders to respond to and investigate security incidents, perform in\-depth forensic analysis to understand the nature and impact of threats, and provide detailed reports and briefings on threat hunting activities and findings to senior management.
  
  

**Minimum Requirements:**  

* 2\+ years of system\-level cybersecurity experience in one of the following areas:
* Cyber Security Analyst, Incident Response and Threat Hunting as part of a mid to large enterprise red team or threat hunt team.
* Enterprise vulnerability management, endpoint security, or web security within a mid to large enterprise.
* Active Top\-Secret Clearance, eligible for TS/SCI.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Security or related field, or equivalent combination of experience.
* Must meet DoD 8140/8570\.01\-M IAM II or IAT Level II requirements (e.g., CCNA Security, CySA\+, GICSP, Security\+ CE, CND, SSCP, CAP, CASP\+ CE, CISM, CISSP (or Associate), GSLC, CCISO, HCISPP, CEH, Pentest\+, OSCP, CSSP\-IR). At least one certification is required.


**Required Skills:**  

* Able to read, decipher and understand system, network, or cloud logs
* Knowledge of basic Enterprise and Network operations.
* Knowledge of NIST Cybersecurity Framework and/or ISO 27001 (specifically focused on incident response procedures, including containment, eradication, and recovery.)
* Basic understanding of Mitter Attack framework
* Communication \& Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively articulate technical findings and collaborate with diverse teams.


**Recommended skills:**  

Threat Hunting \& Detection
  
* Conduct proactive threat hunting activities to detect advanced threats that evade traditional security solutions
* Continuously monitor and analyze threat intelligence sources to stay informed about emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack vectors
* Search for signs of malicious activity across network infrastructure, endpoints, cloud environments, and systems
* Develop and implement new and innovative threat detection techniques and strategies
* Analyze large datasets using SIEM platforms and security analytics tools to identify patterns and anomalies indicative of malicious activities
* Tune detection logic and alerting to reduce false positives and improve threat detection fidelity


Threat Intelligence \& Analysis
  
* Leverage threat intelligence sources to identify emerging threats targeting federal environments and national security systems
* Map adversary activity to MITRE ATT\&CK framework and develop threat models
* Analyze advanced persistent threats (APTs) and understand adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs)
* Recommend defensive improvements based on observed threat actor behaviors and attack patterns
* Correlate threat intelligence with internal security events to identify potential compromises


Incident Response \& Investigation
  
* Collaborate with other CSOC team members and stakeholders to respond to and investigate security incidents
* Perform in\-depth forensic analysis to understand the nature, scope, and impact of threats
* Conduct root cause analysis and impact assessments for security incidents
* Support containment, eradication, and recovery efforts during security incidents
* Coordinate response actions with SOC analysts, engineering teams, system owners, and government stakeholders
* Document incidents, response actions, and remediation recommendations in accordance with government reporting requirements


**Reporting \& Documentation:**  

* Provide detailed reports and briefings on threat hunting activities and findings to senior management
* Develop and maintain threat hunting playbooks, processes, and procedures
* Document lessons learned and contributed to the continuous improvement of security operations
* Create and maintain technical documentation for detection rules, hunting queries, and analytical methodologies
* Clearly document findings, response actions, and technical recommendations


Continuous Improvement \& Compliance
  
* Participate in the development and refinement of security monitoring and incident response tools and processes
* Assist with security documentation, evidence collection, and audit response
* Validate security configurations against established baselines and policies
* Stay current with the latest cybersecurity trends, threat actor TTPs, and defensive technologies

**About Vantage Data Centers**
==============================

  

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Reliability Engineering**


The Reliability Engineering Department is responsible for ensuring the operational health of critical systems and the implementation of Site Operations best practices. This includes evaluating the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure, maintaining operational availability through maintenance programs, and providing technical support to Site Operations teams. The department also collaborates closely with the Design Engineering team to provide feedback for future data center designs.

**Position Overview**

**This role will be based near any of our North America office locations, following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

The Sr. Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment \- Electrical Design Assurance is responsible for providing operationally focused electrical review and technical assurance for new data center builds, expansions, and major fit\-out projects across the North America portfolio. This role represents Site Operations and Site Deployment during design development, page\-turn reviews, submittal reviews, RFI responses, commissioning strategy alignment, and movement of design packages toward Issued for Construction drawings.


The position ensures that electrical systems are designed and delivered in a manner that is operable, maintainable, safe, reliable, and aligned with long\-term Mission Critical Operations requirements. Working closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and local Site Operations teams, this role brings operator perspective into electrical design decisions before construction execution, procurement, and turnover activities create downstream operational risk.

* Serve as the primary Site Deployment representative for electrical design assurance across assigned campuses, projects, and expansions.
* Participate in design page\-turn reviews and provide operator\-focused comments from concept design through IFC drawing issuance.
* Review electrical design packages, one\-line diagrams, specifications, sequences of operation, equipment schedules, load studies, and drawing sets for operability, maintainability, safety, and reliability.
* Review electrical submittals, equipment selections, vendor documentation, and proposed alternates to evaluate operational impact, maintainability requirements, protection strategy, and lifecycle risk.
* Support responses to RFIs related to electrical distribution, equipment access, switching, redundancy, load management, protection coordination, EPMS interfaces, maintenance clearances, and long\-term serviceability.
* Evaluate value engineering proposals and design changes to ensure critical operational requirements are not removed, reduced, or compromised without appropriate risk visibility.
* Provide technical input for electrical commissioning strategies, operational acceptance criteria, test scripts, integrated systems testing, energization plans, and turnover readiness expectations.
* Collaborate with Site Deployment TPMs and future MCO teams to ensure electrical design intent is carried forward into construction, commissioning, training, CMMS population, and steady\-state operations.
* Capture lessons learned from active operating sites and deployment projects and feed them back into future electrical design standards, templates, and review criteria.

* Review electrical design milestones including 30%, 60%, 90%, IFC, bulletin, and construction revision packages.

* Review MEP coordination impacts where electrical systems interface with mechanical, controls, fire protection, security, architectural, structural, civil, and utility scopes.
* Provide operator perspective on sequence of operations, switching procedures, alarm strategy, metering, trending capability, EPMS points, electrical safety requirements, and emergency operating scenarios.

* Support development of operational design standards, electrical review checklists, lessons learned repositories, and acceptance criteria used by the Site Deployment organization.
* Partner with local MCO leadership to ensure future operators understand electrical design intent, operating limitations, maintenance requirements, and known risk items prior to turnover.

new_jobs.title: Environmental Markets Program Manager

Are you passionate about decarbonization and combating climate change? As Project Manager on Apple's Environmental Initiatives team, you will manage and drive decarbonization of Apple’s product manufacturing at scale through engagement with environmental markets.  

  

In this role you will be part of a nimble global Operations team and will be a key contributor to Apple's strategy for supply chain decarbonization, supporting investment opportunities, market transactions and credit management for renewable energy, nature based solutions and beyond.  

  

You will partner closely with Apple Operations, Finance and Procurement leadership to support and guide transactions in renewable energy and carbon markets to help grow carbon neutral pathways for Apple and its supply chain partners.  

  

**Description**  

  

This dynamic role works within the Environmental Initiatives team to achieve renewable energy targets and carbon credit procurement (e.g. MWhs, MMT C02e, date online, location, etc.), support the associated project/deal pipeline and portfolio, and support sourcing and managing the environmental attribute credits (EACs) and the broader portfolio management. Cross functional collaboration is needed as the role will interact with finance, tax and accounting, legal, procurement, and government affairs.  

  

You will work closely with subject matter experts in renewable energy deals and carbon markets to support deal development, transactions and fulfillment. Key tasks include managing the portfolio assets (ex: EACs or credits), and the associated registries where credits are housed; tracking and preparing reports on portfolio status for the team and for management; supporting due diligence on potential transaction partners or service providers; and supporting access to high\-quality carbon credits for our supply chain actors.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Experience in project finance or business development a plus  

  

Experience in managing cross\-functional stakeholders, negotiating strategic partnerships, and identifying high\-quality investment opportunities that deliver both financial returns and measurable climate impact is a plus  

  

Familiarity with voluntary and/or compliance carbon markets and related quality standards and policy (ex: GHGP, ICVCM, SBTi) is helpful  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

5\+ years of supporting corporations with the provision of renewable energy and/or emission reduction solutions (ex: in voluntary carbon markets) for fulfillment of compliance or voluntary objectives  

  

Familiarity with environmental attribute certificates in energy and carbo  

  

Collaborative team player. Ready to roll up sleeves, as needed, to support several projects and programs  

  

Strong communicator, able to convey difficult topics in simple terms and get to the heart of matters  

  

Occasional travel as needed  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $163,500 and $246,200, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

**Job Description**

**The Role**

The Safety Assurance for Effective Autonomous Driving Software (SAFE\-ADS) department is part of GM’s Global Product Safety, System, and Certification (GPSSC) organization. SAFE\-ADS brings together technical and operational expertise to help ensure the safe development, testing, launch, and continuous improvement of automated driving systems (ADS).


GM is seeking an **Autonomous Vehicle Safety Assurance Technical Program Manager** to lead integrated execution across the SAFE\-ADS operating plan.


This staff individual contributor will bring structure, momentum, and transparency to technically complex workstreams spanning safety risk management, operational safety, human factors, software validation, safety metrics, rules\-of\-the\-road compliance, counterfactual simulation, and related system\-safety interfaces.


The successful candidate will connect strategy to delivery by translating operating\-plan objectives into actionable roadmaps, aligning cross\-functional teams to milestones and measurable outcomes, managing technical dependencies and risks, and driving decisions to closure across engineering, validation, data, operations, legal, public policy, and product organizations.


This role is ideal for an experienced technical program leader who can operate at both the systems level and in execution details, communicate effectively with technical and executive audiences, and improve the processes and tools used to deliver safety\-critical software and assurance programs.


**What** **You’ll** **Do**

Program Execution


* Own the integrated execution model for SAFE\-ADS operating\-plan initiatives, including objectives , milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, decisions, and deliverables.
* Translate product requirements, program milestones, and operating \-plan commitments into clear workstream charters, roadmaps, delivery plans, and ownership models.
* Coordinate planning\-cycle updates and ensure changes to scope, priorities, dependencies, and capacity are reflected across relevant plans.
* Establish governance, status reporting, action tracking, decision logs, escalation paths, and program reviews that keep execution visible and predictable.
* Drive risk mitigation and recovery plans, escalating technical, schedule, resource, and dependency issues with decision\-ready recommendations.
* Partner with engineering, operations, quality, Legal, and GPSSC stakeholders on incident response, investigations, corrective actions, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.
* Improve workflows, dashboards, automations, and data quality across Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, SharePoint , requirements tools, and related systems.
Safety Assurance


* Manage dependencies among human\-factors studies, operational data, safety requirements, validation criteria, readiness assessments, and program milestones.
* Lead cross\-functional execution for aggregate safety metrics and rules\-of\-the\-road initiatives, including metric definitions, data quality, benchmarking, targets, validation, dashboards, and monitoring.
* Coordinate interfaces with functional safety, SOTIF, ADAS and AV system safety, architecture, sensing and integration, software validation, simulation, data engineering, platform, and vehicle\-integration teams.
* Ensure requirements, assumptions, design changes, validation activities, and readiness decisions are visible across workstreams and linked to program outcomes.
* Translate technical trade\-offs and impact assessments into clear program decisions, actions, risks, and leadership communications.
* Coordinate the supporting work needed to keep assurance deliverables, evidence plans, assessments, and readiness decisions aligned with program milestones.
* Facilitate alignment among safety objectives , claims, sufficiency criteria, requirements, test plans, evidence owners, assessment activities, and documented decisions.
* Maintain traceability across requirements, work items, tests, metrics, evidence, risks, changes, and approvals using appropriate systems and tools.
**Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, systems engineering, robotics, safety engineering, mathematics, or a related technical field.
* 7\+ years of relevant experience leading complex technical programs in autonomous vehicles, ADAS, software\-intensive systems, systems engineering, product safety, safety assurance, or another safety\-critical domain.
* At least 3 years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, software delivery, systems engineering leadership, or an equivalent role with responsibility for execution across multiple technical teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional programs with multiple workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies, and enterprise\-level visibility.
* Strong program management capabilities, including integrated planning, roadmap and milestone management, dependency tracking, risk and issue management, governance, change control, resource planning, and executive communication.
* Experience translating ambiguous technical objectives into structured execution plans, measurable outcomes, clear ownership, and decision\-ready reporting.
* Experience working with software development lifecycles, software validation, test and verification activities, release planning, CI/CD or equivalent engineering workflows, and production\-readiness practices.
* Working knowledge of requirements management, end\-to\-end traceability, configuration management, impact analysis, evidence management, and assessment processes.
* Hands\-on experience with Jira and familiarity with Jira Align, Confluence, SharePoint, Smartsheet, or comparable program\-management and collaboration tools.
* Experience using or administering requirements and traceability tools such as IBM DOORS Next Generation (DNG), Jama Connect, or equivalent systems.
* Familiarity with metric
